new_roles.description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
**Group Summary**
Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**
**Role Summary**
The Regional Quality Director will be responsible for QM systems with regard to Product Portfolio, Programs and Projects to secure quality according to effective internal and external standards such as QS 9000, ISO/TS 16949/IATF, 14001, 18001, VDA, MQS, etc. to meet Legal, Company and Customer requirements and standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure effectiveness of the Magna Electronics Quality Management (QM) System.
* Managing all QM activities with regards to execution and achievement of corporate Quality goals.
* Executing the global quality strategy and goals, in particular the achievement of certified QM systems in the Division and Engineering Centers.
* Track and maintain data analysis of key metrics and performance data as it relates to the global quality strategy and results.
* Support Division management in executing quality policies; improve the sense of quality ownership in employees by corresponding measures, including establishing standards.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers to achieve site targets and ensure Lessons Learned / Best Practice in respect of Quality.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers in cases of containments, customer and warranty claims; executing root cause analysis, corrective actions and verification of effectiveness.
* Ownership in change management systems with respect to all quality-system related subjects.
* Engage in internal Program and Project reviews of Program Management and customer meetings in aspects of Quality.
* Interact with Division Quality, Production Operations, Product Development and Program Quality to meet or exceed internal and external customer quality performance targets.
* Support the sales and purchasing team in customer negotiations and supplier quality relevant topics.
* Engage in Quality advance planning and execution and support launch activities to meet timing and quality standards.
* Promote quality performance improvement throughout the organization.
* Ensure QM systems correspond to Magna Corporate and ME Group Requirements.
* Maintains regular attendance.
* Follows safe work procedures; Uses appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE); Uses workplace tools and equipment as instructed; Reports workplace hazards, injuries and illness as soon as possible following event.
* Complies with the requirements of Magna Quality System (MQS).

**Key Qualifications/Requirements**

* Excellent knowledge in effective quality standards within the automotive industry
* Knowledge of implementing and maintaining QM systems and its auditing/assessment internal and external dealing with suppliers and customers
* Experience with presentation and moderation techniques
* Comprehensive knowledge of APQP/PPAP
* Excellent knowledge in use of statistical methods and Quality Core Tools (e.g. SPC, 8D, 5Why, Ishikawa, FMEA & CP, etc.)
* Comprehensive knowledge of Root cause analysis and Problem Solving Methods (e.g. Shainin, Red X, Six Sigma, etc.)

**Education**

* Technical degree in Mechanics or Electronics required. Experienced in Quality Operations; Quality Manager/Director. Minimum of 10+ years’ global quality management experience working within the automotive electronics industry.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within the automotive electronics industry, including responsibility for multi-site or regional quality management systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality strategy, certified QM systems, audits, customer quality performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and engineering environments.
* Proven ability to partner with Division, Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Sales, Purchasing, and customer teams to resolve complex quality issues and improve performance.
* Experience leading containment, warranty, customer claim, root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness processes.
* Prior experience as a Quality Manager, Quality Director, or equivalent senior quality leadership role in a global or matrixed organization.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
 
 
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
 
 
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
 
 
**Worker Type**
Regular / Permanent
 
 
**Group**
Magna Electronics

new_roles.title: Director, Quality
new_roles.description:
**Description**
The Director of Quality is responsible for the strategic leadership, execution, and continuous improvement of Aircraft Reconfig Technologies' Quality Management System (QMS). This position ensures compliance with all applicable FAA regulations, Organization Designation Authorization (ODA) requirements, customer specifications, and company policies across engineering, manufacturing, modification, repair station, and certification activities.
 
 
The Director of Quality leads all quality assurance and inspection functions, including receiving, in-process, and final inspection; audit programs; corrective and preventive actions; nonconformance management; and regulatory compliance. The role serves as the primary interface with the FAA, customers, and external auditors while driving a culture of safety, accountability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
 
 
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Lead and maintain the Quality Management System to ensure compliance with FAA regulations, ODA requirements, customer standards, and contractual obligations.
* Establish and continuously improve quality policies, procedures, inspection programs, and quality metrics that drive operational excellence and product conformity.
* Provide leadership for all quality assurance and inspection activities, including receiving, in-process, first article, and final inspection.
* Serve as the primary quality interface with the FAA, customers, auditors, and regulatory authorities, ensuring successful audits and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Lead root cause investigations, corrective actions, preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and improve operational performance.
* Oversee the disposition of nonconforming material through Material Review Board (MRB) activities and associated risk assessment processes.
* Partner with Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Repair Station leadership to ensure quality objectives are integrated into all business activities.
* Develop and monitor quality performance metrics, dashboards, and reporting to drive accountability and informed decision-making.
* Build, develop, and lead a high-performing quality organization through effective staffing, training, coaching, and succession planning.
* Manage departmental resources, budgets, and capital requirements to support quality objectives and business growth.
* Ensure inspection personnel are appropriately trained, qualified, and current with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Foster a culture of compliance, safety, ownership, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Support strategic initiatives, business growth activities, customer pursuits, and certification programs as required.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**What You Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* Associate degree in Engineering, Aviation, Business, Operations, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum ten (10) years of aviation quality, manufacturing, certification, or regulatory compliance experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality organizations and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience interfacing with the FAA on Part 21, Part 145, Production Approval Holder (PAH), and certification-related activities.
* Strong working knowledge of 14 CFR Parts 21, 25, 43, 45, 145, and 183.
* Experience managing quality systems in FAA-regulated manufacturing, modification, and/or repair organizations.
* Working knowledge of AS9100, ISO-based quality systems, auditing practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, certification data, bills of material, and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, root cause analysis, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and procedure development.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, quality management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aviation, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) Certificate.
* Experience working within an FAA Organization Designation Authorization (ODA) environment.
* Experience supporting FAA Certificate Management Section (CMS) oversight activities.
* AS9100 Lead Auditor, Six Sigma, Lean, or other relevant quality certifications.
* Experience supporting aircraft interiors, monuments, cabin modifications, STC programs, and aerospace manufacturing operations.

**The rewards of your career at AAR go far beyond just your salary:**

* Competitive salary and bonus package.
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
* Generous paid time off program.
* Professional development and career advancement opportunities

**Physical Demands/Work Environment**

* The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach and move about the facility.
* Work is performed in a combination of office, manufacturing and warehouse environments.
* The role requires regular sitting, standing, walking, bending, reaching, and movement throughout production and operational areas.
* Frequent interaction with manufacturing, repair station, and inspection activities may require extended periods on the production floor.
* Must be able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 20 pounds.
* Position may require travel within company facilities, customer locations, supplier sites, and regulatory agencies.
* Exposure to manufacturing equipment, aircraft environments, chemicals, moving machinery, and noise levels that may exceed 85 dB. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) will be required when applicable.
* Must possess sufficient visual acuity, hearing, and mobility to perform inspections, review technical documentation, and safely navigate office and production environments.
* Ability to work extended hours, evenings, or weekends as necessary to support business, operational, customer, or regulatory requirements.

AAR provides accommodation in accordance with applicable laws through all stages of the hiring process. If you require accommodation for any part of the application and/or hiring process, please advise Human Resources.
 
 
**Primary Location**
United States-North Carolina-Greensboro-AAR Aircraft Services Greensboro
 
 
**Schedule**
Full-time
 
 
**Overtime Status**
ExemptWe are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.
 
 
The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements.
 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site’s AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification.
 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.
 
 
Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense).
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**Itar Requirements**
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
 
 

* 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
* 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Travel Requirements**
Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.
 
 
Salary Range
 
 
$140,000 - $180,000 USD
 
 
Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Director- Quality Management**
The Parker Jewish Institute for Health Care and Rehabilitation, located in New Hyde Park, NY, seeks a full-time
**Director for Quality Management**
. This individual will support the skilled nursing facility.
 
 
This position will lead all aspects of quality (performance) improvement activities for the organization, overseeing/coordinating all activities of the organization relating to regulatory and external compliance requirements. Acts as a resource for regulatory standards interpretation/application, including internal audits for regulatory compliance.
 
 
**About Parker**
The Parker Jewish Institute for Health Care and Rehabilitation, conveniently located on the Queens-Nassau County border in New Hyde Park, New York, is a non-profit health care facility that offers inpatient programs such as sub-acute/short term rehabilitation and long-term care, as well as community health services, encompassing certified home health care and a comprehensive community hospice program, that serves terminally ill patients in their own homes or in nursing facilities.
 
 
Quality care means hiring quality people, and Parker Jewish Institute for Health Care and Rehabilitation has a longstanding reputation for excellence and innovation in resident/patient care.
 
 
**Why Work At Parker**

* Friendly, collaborative team environment and exciting career growth opportunities providing an opportunity to learn, grow and have an impact on the overall results
* Excellent training and clinical education
* Accessible via public transportation
* Free parking on site for all staff
* On-site cafeteria offering breakfast and lunch
* Full Benefits for Full-Time staff include Health Insurance, 401k, Vacation, Holiday and Sick Time

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's Degree (preferred) in relevant health field.
* CPHQ certification a plus.
* At least five years' clinical nursing experience and quality assurance or quality management experience.
* Must have thorough knowledge of and understanding of QAPI and QM principles and practices.
* Must be familiar with State DOH, and all applicable codes and regulations.
* Must have excellent verbal and communication skills.

new_roles.description:
ADM – Soy Crush
 
 
This is an exempt level position.
 
 
**Position Summary**
This key operational role is responsible for leading all aspects of the operations at a soy white flake crush processing facility with an integrated refinery. You will have a leading role in driving excellence, developing and implementing programs and procedures, and developing a manufacturing team. You set and maintain ADM’s high standards for Safety and Quality for all departments while maintaining production and efficiency excellence. A good communicator who can nurture extraordinary interdepartmental, commercial and customer relationships will be most successful. He/she will have the ability to identify and conclusively solve problems as they arise, develop and supervise capital improvement projects and maintain records in accordance with established ADM policies.
 
 
The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Regional Operations and leads a site with approximately 40 colleagues.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead a soy white flake crush plant and refinery.
* Develop a high performance team by engaging, coaching and developing team members, and by driving accountability and ownership at all levels.
* Responsible for environmental, health, safety, quality, efficiency and production of the plant.
* Responsible for meeting production requirements safely, reliably, and efficiently.
* Lead and support performance excellence initiatives.
* Provide technical knowledge for processes and equipment to obtain performance leveraging ADM Centers of Excellence.
* Maintain cost controls and oversee budgets in each department.
* Utilize production personnel and equipment in a safe and efficient manner to obtain maximum capacity and performance with optimum yields and quality product.
* Develop and implement a five year capital plan in alignment with the business strategy.

**Health, Safety & Environmental:**

* Maintain the license to operate by developing a strong site safety culture and by ensuring adherence to safety laws, regulations, rules and sound practices.
* Act as a role model for safety.
* Work with the Safety and Environmental Center of Excellence and the regional and local management on the continued development and implementation of environmental, health, and safety programs, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and contribute in audits, prioritizing and tracking completion of findings.
* Ensure that unsafe behavior and conditions are corrected.
* Maintain the necessary environmental, health, and safety records and documentation.

**Sanitation/Food Safety:**

* Ensure the facility maintains world-class sanitation standards.
* Continually improve and communicate food safety/sanitation/quality programs to plant supervisors and hourly employees.
* Prepare the facility for, and participate in, regulatory/third party/customer/company audits.

**Required Skills:**

* Four-year degree in a technical field, engineering degree preferred, and a minimum of four years of supervisory experience with increasing manufacturing leadership responsibility, or a minimum of six years of hands-on, increasing production leadership experience.
* Previous experience in oilseeds operations highly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership in safety.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate for achievement and communicate effectively.
* Demonstrated coaching and leadership skills.

Excited about this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings.
 
 
ADM requires the successful completion of a background check.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Job ID: 528020
 
 
Ash Grove family of companies is one of North America's leading cement manufacturers, with a legacy of innovation and excellence dating back to 1882. The company operates 12 world-class cement plants and a vast network of 41 terminals across the United States and Canada. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, Ash Grove combines technical expertise, robust safety standards, and empowered talent to deliver high performance and better serve our customers. At Ash Grove, we stand together to reinvent the way our world is built.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*At Ash Grove Cement, people are our first priority. We offer a complete benefits package to include:\*\*
 
 

* \*\*Health Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Dental Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Vision Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Retirement Plan\*\*
* \*\*Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays\*\*
* \*\*Tuition Reimbursement\*\*
* \*\*Employee Assistance Program\*\*
* \*\*Disability Pay\*\*
* \*\*Life Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Growth Opportunities and more!\*\*

**Summary**
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
**What You'll Be Contributing**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.
* Additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**To Succeed In This Position, You Will Need**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year Bachelor's Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Minimum 10 years of experience in a cement or lime manufacturing facility with specific exposure to plant management responsibilities. Type of experience - cement or lime - depends on the specific type of plant with the position under consideration.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy
* What's next for you?\*\*

We provide stability and advancement opportunities across North America. Use our tuition reimbursement program to help you meet your career goals.
 
 
\_The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. The physical demands, working environment, and other conditions of employment listed in this document are representative of but are not intended to provide an exhaustive list of the requirements for positions in this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.\_
 
 
\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - BCV
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager**
**Why Byrne**
At Byrne, we foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, and professionalism. Our greatest strength lies in the exceptional talent and dedication of our team members across every part of the organization. We value their contributions and ensure they’re recognized, rewarded, and compensated in ways that reflect their impact and expertise.
 
 
**Pay And Benefits**

* Salary Range – $125,000 - $152,500 per year
* Competitive bonus programs
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits available day 1 of employment
* Supplemental benefits available on day 30 of employment
* Eligible for 401 (k) with a company match available on day 90 of employment
* Educational Support via tuition reimbursement and scholarship program

**Work Shift and Location**
3156 Byrne Hollow Crossing Cortland, NY 13045
 
 
Monday – Friday normal business hours. This may require evening, night and weekend availability based on business needs.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Plant Manager plays a key role in executing assigned Production tasks. This includes leading various teams in production efforts in addition to performing the duties as needed to efficiently facilitate plant operations. The Plant Manager is also responsible for ensuring that the plant products manufactured conform to company-defined product quality standards, as well as Federal, State, and local standards of product identity, safety, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the plant; coordinate and direct plant operations in the achievement of production, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Ensure an appropriate volume of production and raw inventories for each product produced to maximize machine efficiencies and minimize down time and stock outs.
* Manage plant budget and expenses to fall within, or better than plan. Manage all plant variances to meet or exceed plan including, but not limited to, headcount, overtime, and spending.
* Ensure that the quality of products produced at the facility is consistent with intended design and desired image.
* Coordinate with Plant Production Scheduler, Warehouse Management and Supply Management to ensure needed dry goods are on-hand as required.
* Establish and administer mechanisms for being alerted when suppliers are going to be late for delivery or cut items on a delivery. Take action to minimize impact on production schedules and alert appropriate sales and logistics personnel.
* Provide planning assistance with physical inventories and provide staffing to perform these activities; ensure accuracy of all inventories at all times.
* Ensure reporting mechanism regarding KPI are in-place and functioning; ensure monthly reporting of critical KPI to company leadership and plant staff.
* Monitor intake procedures of raw dairy products to assure quality standards are met and production shortages are avoided.
* Contributes to the development of budgets and cost controls. Ensure direct reports analyze, budget, and control spending for their respective line accounts.
* Facilitate the development of strategies and corrective actions to resolve quality issues as necessary.
* Implements and maintains manufacturing policies, procedures, and production control programs.
* Must ensure full compliance with all quality assurance standards.
* Provide for the development, prioritization, and execution of capital improvement projects within the facility.
* Provide leadership for effective employee relations through positive communication, coaching, training, problem resolution/corrective actions, and floor time, work cooperatively with Human Resources.
* Coordinate production activities with purchasing, sales, warehousing, distribution, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of staff and equipment.
* Provide for the personal and professional growth of team through coaching, feedback, and opportunity.
* Foster participation of the workforce to enhance awareness and cooperation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and all government regulations; Ensure compliance and enforcement of all work rules and regulations to plant operations and all applicable employees.
* Ensure proper GMP and sanitation procedures are followed plant-wide in collaboration with the quality unit.
* Communicate with Human Resource Department on needs of the facility.
* Rigorously assess your leadership and technical team in terms of values, adherence to SOPs/GMPs, and actual results.
* Foster an “open door” policy for all employees to maintain an open line of communication between direct reports and management staff.
* Promote and provide excellent customer service for all customers.
* Promote a safe and harmonious work environment and adherence to company policy and procedures.
* Responsible for ensuring direct reports assigned duties and responsibilities are covered during planned and unplanned absence from work, including acting as a backup as necessary.

**Min. Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Business Administration or related field, with an MBA preferred.
* Minimum 5-7 years in the role of Managing a Production facility.
* Related experience in the dairy food industry.
* Certifications to include but not limited to CPT, HACCP, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid, CPR and AED.

**Byrne**
Headquartered in LaFayette, Byrne is a Central New York-based dairy company with a legacy spanning over 90 years. Its operations include an extended shelf-life (ESL) and ultra-high temperature (UHT) pasteurization plant in DeWitt, as well as an ESL manufacturing facility in Cortlandville. Byrne also maintains warehouse facilities in Syracuse and East Syracuse, along with a dedicated ice cream center in Syracuse. As a recognized industry leader, Byrne continues to drive innovation at the forefront of dairy processing and product development.

new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:**
Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.
 
 
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**
:
 
 

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**Language Skills**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**Mathematical Skills**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**Reasoning Ability**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**Technical Skills**
The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:
 
 

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**Physical Demands**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**Leadership Attributes**
The individual must posses the following:
 
 

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**Performance Measurements**
The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:
 
 

* Operating standards - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations**
- through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
new_roles.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
The
**Director, Manufacturing Engineering**
provides functional and strategic leadership for the manufacturing engineering organization, accountable for process capability, producibility, and product quality across production programs. This role leads a team of managers and engineers responsible for developing, deploying, and continuously improving manufacturing, test, and related industrial engineering processes to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in
**Baltimore, MD**
.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Functional & People Leadership

+ Lead and develop a high‑performing manufacturing engineering organization, including managers, engineers, and supporting staff.
+ Define and maintain functional standards, methods, tools, and best practices for manufacturing engineering across the site or business.
+ Recruit, develop, and retain talent; drive succession planning, leadership development, and engagement/inclusion activities.
+ Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development for managers and engineers.

* Manufacturing Engineering Ownership

+ Own manufacturing engineering processes from new product introduction through sustainment, ensuring robust process controls, standard work, and documented work instructions.
+ Direct the creation and maintenance of MBOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling, and strategies that enable safe, efficient, and high‑quality production.
+ Drive producibility into designs by partnering with Design Engineering early in the lifecycle; ensure effective transition to production and rate readiness.
+ Establish and manage key performance indicators (yields, scrap, rework, cycle time, labor efficiency) and drive continuous improvement using data‑driven methods.

* Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

+ Partner closely with Operations, Quality & Mission Excellence, and Supply Chain to ensure stable processes and timely resolution of production issues.
+ Oversee manufacturing engineering participation in MRB and nonconformance disposition; ensure effective root‑cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
+ Champion initiatives to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
+ Lead manufacturing engineering support to factory readiness, capacity planning, and rate ramp‑ups.

* Program, Financial, and Strategic Management

+ Align functional objectives, resources, and priorities with program and business needs; balance near‑term execution with long‑term capability development.
+ Partner with Program Management and Business Management to support bids, proposals, and program execution, including manufacturing scope, risk, and cost/schedule inputs.
+ Own manufacturing engineering budgets (labor, capital, and expense) and apply sound financial management.
+ Develop and execute technology roadmaps and capital investment plans for manufacturing processes, equipment, and facilities.

* Compliance, Governance, and Stakeholder Management

+ Ensure manufacturing engineering processes comply with regulatory requirements, customer standards, and internal procedures.
+ Represent manufacturing engineering in internal and external reviews, audits, and customer engagements.
+ Build strong relationships with sector/site leadership, program teams, and functional peers to drive alignment and resolve cross‑functional constraints.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 10 or more years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 8 or more years of relevant experience.
* 3 or more years of functional management experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing/production, operations, program management, testing, or a related area, including direct leadership of engineers and/or first‑line managers.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing or production engineering supporting complex hardware (e.g., aerospace, defense, electronics, or similar).
* Proven track record of improving manufacturing and test processes, yields, cycle times, and product quality using data and metrics.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing process controls, quality systems, and relevant industry/regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated financial acumen including budgets, rates, and cost management

new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Global Innovation, oversees performance management, operational excellence, and strategic execution for manufacturing entities across Asia, including Vietnam, China, and South Korea. Serves as a key liaison between headquarters and regional production sites, driving data‑driven decision‑making, productivity improvements, and process standardization.
 
 
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Management & Financial Oversight
* Monitor and evaluate the operational and financial performance of manufacturing subsidiaries in Asia
* Develop and manage KPIs
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with regional leadership
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans
* Strategic Planning & Execution
* Formulate mid- to long-term manufacturing and supply chain strategies aligned with global business objectives
* Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and footprint strategy (e.g., China+1, nearshoring)
* Conduct market and operational feasibility analysis for new investments or expansions
* Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production sites (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)
* Standardize processes and implement best practices across regions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Procurement, Logistics, Quality, R&D) to improve end-to-end efficiency
* HQ–Regional Coordination
* Act as the primary liaison between HQ and Asia manufacturing teams
* Ensure alignment on corporate policies, reporting standards, and operational priorities
* Facilitate communication, issue resolution, and project execution across time zones
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting systems for real-time performance tracking
* Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights and executive-level reports
* Support digital transformation initiatives (ERP, MES, data integration)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred)
* 7–10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or operations strategy roles
* Proven experience managing or overseeing operations in Asia (Vietnam, China, Korea preferred)
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI/Tableau, or similar tools
* Deep understanding of manufacturing KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Multilingual capability (Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese is a plus)
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to travel internationally (20–40%)

**Benefits**

* Premium Medical Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) based on seniority
* Paid Holidays

**Additional Workplace Offerings (subject To Change Or Eligibility.)**

* Annual Bonus Plan
* Onsite Employee Fitness Center with Indoor Racquetball Court and Yoga Room
* Summer Fridays
* Complimentary Gourmet Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
* Relocation Support for New Hires
* Work Anniversary Recognitions
* Congratulatory & Condolence Gifts
* Employee Referral Bonus Program
* License/Certification Reimbursements
* Corporate Employee Discounts
* Visa Sponsorships (100% paid by the company) i.e., New H-1B, H-1B Transfer, O-1, and Green Card
* Commuter Support (Shuttle Bus Program and EZPass Support)
* Vehicle Perks

**Qualification(s)**
**Education(s):**
Bachelor of Science (B.S) (Required)
 
 
**Work Experience**
Experience Range V: +13 years of relevant experience or industry exposure in a related field
 
 
**Skill(s)**
Lean Process Improvements, Manufacturing, Operational Strategies, Six Sigma Framework, Supply Chain
 
 
**Language(s)**
English, Korean
 
 
**Certification(s)**
Not Applicable

91,000.00 - 172,000.00 USD Annual

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Production
new_roles.description:
**Career Area**
Manufacturing
 
 
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 
Caterpillar is seeking a
**Senior Manager Production**
to provide senior leadership for production operations at our Griffin Engine Packaging Plant. This role serves as a key production leader responsible for overseeing genset and power module manufacturing operations in a fast-paced, high-velocity production environment.
 
 
As the leader of a team consisting of seven direct-report supervisors and multiple indirect reports, you will drive operational performance across safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives while creating an environment focused on employee development and operational excellence.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to lead large-scale power systems production operations, overseeing products ranging from approximately 400 kVA to 4 MW. The successful candidate will champion a safety-first culture, support lean manufacturing initiatives, and provide leadership for day-to-day operational execution and continuous improvement efforts.
 
 
How You Will Make an Impact
 
 

* Safety-Driven Culture - Lead with a safety-first mindset and drive a culture where safety is the top operational priority.
* Operational Excellence - Deliver strong manufacturing performance through effective management of safety, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* People Leadership and Development - Develop, coach, and support leaders while building organizational capability across the production team.
* Lean Manufacturing Leadership - Champion lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance.
* Large-Scale Power Systems Production - Provide leadership for genset and power module production operations supporting a complex manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities Include**

* Leading production operations within a high-velocity manufacturing environment.
* Driving safety performance and fostering a safety-first culture throughout the organization.
* Managing competing priorities related to safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
* Leading employee development activities and performance management processes.
* Resolving day-to-day operational escalations and manufacturing challenges.
* Supporting lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Overseeing genset and power module production operations.; emphasis on NPI operational support (i.e headcount, capacity planning, etc...)

Degree Requirement
 
 
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
 
 
**What Skills You Will Have**
**Production Training:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools and techniques for delivering formal and informal training on the safe and efficient operation of production machinery; ability to conduct effective formal and situation-specific training.
 
 
**Problem Solving:**
Extensive knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations
 
 
**Influencing:**
Extensive knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.
 
 
**Flexibility and Adaptability:**
Extensive knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change.
 
 
**Performance Management:**
Extensive knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.
 
 
**Analytical Thinking:**
Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
 
 
**Planning and Organizing:**
Extensive knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
 
 
**Effective Communications:**
Extensive understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
 
 
**Leadership & People Management:**
Extensive understanding of the techniques and skills needed to lead in the production environment; with the demonstrated ability to develop talent using performance management techniques
 
 
Top Candidates Will Also Have
 
 

* Experiences as a leader of leaders; specifically in cross-functional teams with support staff
* Manufacturing experience in the product producing environment; preference for heavy equipment, automotive, aerospace, rail, or other closely related industries.
* Examples of contributing to or leading manufacturing process transformation
* LEAN/Six Sigma Certification.

Additional Information
 
 

* Location: Griffin, Georgia
* Work Arrangement: Onsite
* Relocation: Available
* Travel: Less than 10%
* Sponsorship: Not available

**Summary Pay Range**
$147,760.00 - $221,640.00
 
 
Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.
 
 
**Benefits**
Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
 
 

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits\*
* Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\*
* 401(k) savings plans\*
* Health Savings Account (HSA)\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\*
* Health Lifestyle Programs\*
* Employee Assistance Program\*
* Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\*
* Career Development\*
* Incentive bonus\*
* Disability benefits
* Life Insurance
* Parental leave
* Adoption benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement
* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
 
 
Relocation is available for this position.
 
 
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
 
 
**Posting Dates**
November 11, 2026 - November 18, 2026
 
 
Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.
 
 
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
 
 
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
new_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.
 
 
The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.
 
 
**What You'll Do**
Development Program Materials Planning
 
 

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness
 
 

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership
 
 

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI**
At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.
 
 
#LD
 
 
**Full-time Regular Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity
 
 
**Temporary Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)
 
 
Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.
 
 
###
 
 
Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
 
 
Compensation Range: $167,328 - $250,992

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Umoja Biopharma is an industry-leading biotech with locations in Seattle, WA and Louisville, CO, focused on transforming the treatment of cancer with a novel integrated immunotherapy platform. Our vision is to develop off-the-shelf therapies capable of treating any tumor, any time. We are a diverse and growing team working in brand-new facilities in downtown Seattle, Washington and Louisville, Colorado, and we are looking for innovative thinkers who are excited by groundbreaking science and technology, and passionate about squaring up to the challenges inherent to cutting-edge drug development. We are committed to our core values and principles that support our overall mission and strongly invite applications from enthusiastic individuals who share our commitment and help position Umoja to deliver on our goals. We at Umoja believe in the importance of stories; we are looking for great people to join our team to help us create more stories for ourselves, for you, and most importantly for patients and their families.
 
 
Umoja Biopharma – Your Body. Your Hope. Your Cure.
 
 
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Manager of Manufacturing who has strong leadership capabilities and extensive manufacturing experience to lead our Drug substance fill and Drug product Manufacturing team. This is a newly created position reporting into the head of Manufacturing at our Louisville, Colorado GMP cell/gene Manufacturing facility. This person will play a critical role helping lead the manufacturing team through a period of growth and change as we advance our clinical pipeline to later phases of development.
 
 
Primary job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, commercial launch readiness planning and project leadership, DS/DP fill process and material improvements identification and implementation management, ensuring staff is fully trained and qualified to execute aseptic fills and DP visual inspection, ensuring high aseptic technique standards, and assisting with tech transfers both internally and externally. They will also be expected to lead continuous improvement initiatives and provide strategic planning to ensure a high operational success rate. Success is measured by successful outcomes of drug substance film and drug product manufacturing operations.
 
 
This role will interact with internal process engineers, Process sciences, facilities, warehouse/supply chain, EHS, Quality Assurance, and Quality Control on a regular basis. Strong communication and risk-based strategic leadership skills are essential to effectively work in this matrix environment. This is an opportunity to be part of an excellent team working in an exciting environment, focused on realizing the challenge of targeting solid tumors successfully with novel cell/gene therapies.
 
 
This role will be fully onsite at our Louisville, CO facility. This person will need to be able to work weekends, holidays, or evenings when needed.
 
 
**Core Accountabilities**

* Lead successful completion of the drug product fill process, the final step in ensuring product safety and efficacy for patients.
* Strategizes and coordinates the execution and continuous improvement of compliant and technically sound programs and systems in support of Drug substance fill and Drug product GMP manufacturing operations (e.g., aseptic process simulations, drug product process continuous improvement and validation)
* Authors and reviews-controlled documents and standard operating procedures on behalf of Manufacturing Operations
* Partners with Process Science to co-lead both internal and external technology transfer of drug product manufacturing processes at various scales.
* Supports manufacturing process execution through on the floor escalation troubleshooting and risk-based, patient focused decision making
* Supports deviation investigations in the drug substance fill, drug product process area to correct root cause and appropriate corrective actions.
* Ensures adherence to Standard Operating Procedures, good manufacturing practices, and good documentation practices
* Identify, strategize, and lead commercial launch readiness initiates in the DP area in partnership with collaborating functions (e.g., Process sciences, Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Supply chain)
* Manage material quality issues to improvements by partnering with external QA and supply chain to implement new materials or higher supplier specifications
* Ensures DP manufacturing operational excellence and run success rates by driving continuous improvement initiatives and holding high execution standards
* Manage, mentor, and develop DP manufacturing team members, including creation of thorough and clear training content/expectations
* On-the-floor Manufacturing support as needed approximately 25% of time
* Other duties as needed

**Required Qualifications**

* Manager Level: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related life sciences field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Desired qualifications include 10+ years of cGMP manufacturing experience in the pharmaceutical or biologics industry and a minimum of 4 years of people management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Senior Manager Level: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related life sciences field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Desired qualifications include 12+ years of cGMP manufacturing experience in the pharmaceutical or biologics industry and a minimum of 6 years of people management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to make critical decisions and exercise sound judgment to mitigate significant risks to the company. Aseptic drug product expert and trainer (drug product filling, visual inspection, process validation)
* Experience hiring, training, and managing individual employee and team performance by setting expectations, giving feedback, and monitoring progress.
* Demonstrated results-oriented experience leading a team through successful DP commercial launch

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience leading external technology transfer is strongly preferred
* Proficient in computer applications such as word processing, spreadsheets, and web-based applications
* Self-motivated with strong organization and communication skills and can work independently or as part of a multi-disciplinary matrixed team.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to aseptically gown into lentiviral clean-room environments (ISO5, ISO7, ISO8, ISO9)
* Must have the ability to work around manufacturing areas and equipment
* The ability to be on the manufacturing floor during operation
* The ability to periodically lift up to 50lbs
* Ability to work holidays, nights and weekends as needed

**Manager Salary Range: $125,000 - $155,000**
**Senior Manager Salary Range: $147,000 - $182,000**
Benefits Offerings
 
 
*Umoja Biopharma offers its employees competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans. Additionally, we offer Umojians access to a 401k plan through Fidelity, with a 100% match up to their first 4% deferral. Umoja also provides a generous Paid Time Off policy, employee commuter benefits, and cell phone stipend. For a full breakdown of our benefits offerings, please see the
**Benefits**
section of our website.*
