new_roles.title: Strategic Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Location:** New York, NY 
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $190,000 base salary + annual bonus 
**Travel:** 25%

In 2017, Shields established the Strategic Operations team to partner directly with the Executive Leadership Team in executing the company's highest-priority initiatives. These efforts span corporate strategy, operational transformation, performance improvement, growth execution, business development, and new business innovation. Team members gain exposure to all aspects of the organization, combining executive-level engagement with hands-on responsibility for translating strategy into measurable results. The team has served as a pathway to leadership, with alumni advancing into senior roles across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership. This role offers the opportunity to build on that legacy while helping shape Shields' next phase of growth and innovation.

The **Director of Strategic Operations** serves as a senior leader responsible for driving strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and growth across Shields' portfolio of health system specialty pharmacy partnerships. This role is ideal for individuals with experience as a **Healthcare Consulting Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Leader, Strategic Operations Leader, Transformation Leader, Management Consultant, or operations executive within a private equity-backed healthcare services organization** seeking an opportunity to influence enterprise-level decision-making and organizational performance.

Leading a team of high-performing professionals, the Director will oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, deliver executive-level analyses and recommendations, and partner directly with senior leaders to drive exceptional clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. Functioning as an internal strategy and operations leader, this individual will identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and translate strategic priorities into measurable results across the organization.

This role is particularly well suited for professionals coming from **healthcare consulting, management consulting, healthcare strategy, portfolio operations, business transformation, performance improvement, or private equity-backed healthcare organizations** who are looking for the opportunity to move beyond recommendations and directly own execution. Success requires strong strategic thinking, structured problem solving, financial and operational acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and resourceful leader who thrives in entrepreneurial settings, excels at managing ambiguity, and has a demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives that drive growth, value creation, operational excellence, and performance improvement.

**Job Duties**

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

* Serve as a key leader within the Strategic Operations team, driving growth, strategic execution, and organizational performance through both direct leadership and individual contributions.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of high-performing professionals responsible for supporting critical business initiatives across the organization.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic and operational initiatives aligned with Shields' highest-priority objectives.
* Synthesize complex operational, financial, and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Strategy, Operations & Performance Improvement**

* Partner directly with Senior Vice Presidents and Regional Vice Presidents of Operations to drive strong financial, operational, and clinical outcomes across Shields' health system partnerships.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to identify, prioritize, and execute strategic objectives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead day-to-day strategy and operational execution for a portfolio of health system partnerships.
* Develop business cases, financial models, forecasts, and performance analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Drive high-impact initiatives focused on operational excellence, growth strategy, performance improvement, transformation, and value creation.
* Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, process improvement, and partnership expansion.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior operational leaders, providing strategic guidance and analytical support.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, Business Development, Clinical, Technology, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams.

### **Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own and cultivate relationships with senior health system executives and key external stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic liaison between Shields leadership and health system partners to ensure alignment on priorities and objectives.
* Support executive presentations, partnership reviews, business planning sessions, and strategic steering committees.
* Translate complex analyses into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.

### **Growth & Innovation**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities, ancillary services, operational enhancements, and growth initiatives that increase partnership value.
* Support strategic planning, business development, market expansion, and innovation efforts across the organization.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging healthcare opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, MPH, or other advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record of strategic and operational leadership within healthcare.
* Experience in one or more of the following environments strongly preferred:
 + **Healthcare Consulting Firms** (Engagement Manager, Manager, Project Leader, Senior Manager, Principal, or equivalent roles)
 + **Private Equity-Backed Healthcare Services Organizations**
 + **Corporate Strategy, Strategic Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Operations, or Performance Improvement Functions**
 + **Health Systems, Specialty Pharmacy, Provider Services, Population Health, Revenue Cycle, or Healthcare Services Organizations**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence, business transformation, growth strategy, and performance improvement initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, performance updates, and business insights to executive leadership teams and Board-level audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, business case development, forecasting, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through influence in highly matrixed organizations.
* Proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and workstreams simultaneously.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25% to engage with health system executives, operational leaders, pharmacists, clinicians, and partnership stakeholders.

 
**Why Join Shields?**

* Partner directly with Executive Leadership on the company's most important strategic priorities.
* Lead high-impact initiatives that drive growth, operational excellence, and transformative outcomes across a national network of health system partnerships.
* Gain broad exposure to corporate strategy, healthcare operations, business development, and executive decision-making.
* Join a proven leadership pipeline that has developed future leaders across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.
* Help shape the future of healthcare through innovative specialty pharmacy solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen health system partnerships.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Reports To:** VP of Operations

**Department:** Operations

**Location:** Beachwood, Ohio-primary location (Toledo, Nursing Home Programs, and Future Service Locations as needed)

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting and executing enterprise operational oversight across multiple behavioral health service lines and locations. This role partners closely with the VP of Operations and executive leadership to ensure operational stability, scalability, compliance, staffing coordination, workflow management, and organizational performance across all assigned programs.

The Director of Operations serves as a key operational leader responsible for driving consistency, accountability, and operational execution across outpatient behavioral health programs, recovery support services, housing operations, nursing home partnerships, and future organizational growth initiatives.

This is a non-clinical leadership role. The Director of Operations does not provide clinical supervision or determine clinical level of care decisions, but works collaboratively with Clinical, Revenue Cycle, Housing, Intake, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams to ensure efficient and compliant operational performance across the enterprise.

This position requires the ability to exercise sound independent judgment, make operational decisions autonomously when appropriate, prioritize competing organizational needs, and respond effectively to rapidly changing operational demands across multiple service lines and locations.

This position is designed to support long-term operational leadership continuity across the organization. Responsibilities may expand or shift based on organizational structure, operational needs, leadership transitions, and enterprise growth initiatives.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Enterprise Operational Oversight
* Support and oversee daily operational functions across multiple behavioral health programs and service locations
* Assist with operational oversight of outpatient behavioral health clinics, recovery support services, housing operations, nursing home partnerships, and future service expansions
* Ensure operational consistency, accountability, and workflow execution across enterprise locations
* Monitor operational performance, staffing needs, workflow barriers, and service delivery coordination
* Independently identify operational issues and implement timely solutions within the scope of organizational expectations
* Exercise independent decision-making related to operational workflow management, staffing coordination, scheduling adjustments, and day-to-day operational needs
* Assist with development and implementation of operational systems, policies, workflows, and accountability structures
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvement initiatives
* Support organizational scalability and stabilization efforts

**Staffing & Workflow Management**

* Oversee operational scheduling processes and staffing coordination across assigned programs
* Monitor staffing coverage, workflow efficiency, transportation coordination, and operational throughput
* Collaborate with department leaders regarding staffing support, scheduling concerns, and operational barriers
* Make operational decisions related to staffing coverage, workflow prioritization, and operational resource allocation when appropriate
* Ensure operational follow-up on workflow disruptions, scheduling gaps, cancellations, and staffing needs
* Support census oversight, operational capacity management, and throughput planning

**Interdepartmental Leadership**

* Partner collaboratively with Clinical, Housing, Revenue Cycle, Intake, Human Resources, Compliance, and Executive Leadership teams
* Support organizational alignment between operational and clinical departments
* Participate in leadership meetings, operational huddles, and enterprise planning initiatives
* Escalate operational concerns, risks, and barriers appropriately
* Assist with implementation of organizational initiatives, workflow changes, and operational directives

new_roles.description:

Weekday Day

Full Time

JR8120

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Opportunity
 
 
The St. Jude Leadership Academy is building the systems, experiences and capabilities that help leaders across St. Jude grow their impact. We’re looking for a Director of Academy Operations who can help turn that vision into an enterprise-scale reality.

This is a role for a builder.

 
 

As the Academy’s primary operational leader and integrator, you’ll translate strategy into an integrated portfolio of work and create the infrastructure needed to move ideas from concept through implementation, evaluation and scale. You’ll work across Leadership Development, Culture Strategy and institutional partners to connect priorities, clarify ownership and turn complex, cross-functional work into coordinated action.

You’ll also serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership, bringing visibility to priorities, tradeoffs, resources and execution risks while helping shape how the Academy delivers its work across St. Jude.

Because the Leadership Academy operates as a small, highly collaborative team, this isn’t a role where strategy gets handed off once the plan is built. You’ll move comfortably between enterprise-level thinking and hands-on execution, building the systems that allow a small team to have an outsized impact across St. Jude.

 
 

### **What You’ll Do**

As Director of Academy Operations, you will:

* **Turn strategy into execution.** Translate Leadership Academy priorities into an integrated portfolio, implementation roadmap and operating plan.
* **Lead complex work from idea to impact.** Guide cross-functional initiatives from concept and design through implementation, evaluation and scale.
* **Build the Academy’s operating infrastructure.** Establish governance, decision points, roles, handoffs, planning processes and operating rhythms that create clarity and accountability.
* **Connect work across St. Jude.** Build strong partnerships across Leadership Development, Culture Strategy and other institutional functions, bringing people and priorities together while maintaining clear roles and ownership.
* **See around corners.** Identify dependencies, duplication, capacity constraints, gaps and execution risks across the Academy’s portfolio and drive solutions.
* **Create visibility into impact.** Establish portfolio-level measures, dashboards and reporting that show progress, outcomes and organizational impact.
* **Help good ideas scale.** Develop practical approaches for moving promising concepts and pilots into sustainable institutional practices.
* **Lead operational and resource planning.** Oversee budgets, resources, technology, vendors, contracts and external partnerships that support the Academy’s work.
* **Drive continuous improvement.** Apply human-centered design, agile and continuous-improvement approaches to strengthen programs, processes and operations.
* **Serve as a strategic advisor.** Help senior leadership navigate priorities, tradeoffs, sequencing, resource allocation and execution risk.
* **Communicate with influence.** Develop executive-level materials and clearly communicate progress, decisions, risks and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* **Stay close to the work.** Remain directly involved in execution when needed, reflecting the hands-on, highly collaborative nature of the Academy team.
* **Develop people and teams.** Create clarity around goals and expectations while supporting performance, engagement, professional growth and meaningful career experiences.
 

 

### **What You Bring**

You are an experienced operations and program leader who knows how to take an ambitious vision and build the structure required to make it real. You are comfortable navigating complexity, influencing across organizational boundaries and leading work when accountability is shared across multiple teams.

You bring:

* A bachelor’s degree; an advanced degree is preferred.
* 10+ years of related professional experience.
* Significant experience leading complex enterprise programs, operations, transformation initiatives or similar work within a large organization.
* Demonstrated experience **building operating models, processes or organizational capabilities**, not simply administering established programs.
* A track record of translating strategic objectives into operational plans and driving those plans through execution.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional work in environments where accountability and authority are distributed.
* Strong strategic program management, operational, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* The ability to move comfortably between enterprise-level strategy and detailed execution.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including experience partnering with senior leaders.
* Experience with budget planning, resource management, vendor relationships and contract negotiations.
* Experience with human-centered design, agile methods, continuous improvement or related approaches.
* Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills.
* Experience in leadership development, organizational development, talent, culture or another people-related function is preferred, but not required.

### **The Kind of Leader Who Will Thrive Here**

This role may be especially compelling if you:

* See complexity and instinctively begin creating clarity and structure.
* Get energy from **building something**, not simply maintaining what already exists.
* Can zoom out to see the enterprise picture and then zoom back in to make sure the details work.
* Know how to lead through influence when the people needed to accomplish the work don’t necessarily report to you.
* Are comfortable asking difficult questions about priorities, capacity, tradeoffs and risk.
* Enjoy turning promising ideas into repeatable, sustainable ways of working.
* Believe measurement should help people make better decisions, not simply create more reporting.
* Approach problems with curiosity and are willing to challenge established ways of working when there is a better path forward.
* Can advise senior leaders one moment and roll up your sleeves to solve an execution problem the next.
* Want to build systems that make it possible for other people to do exceptional work.
 

 
 

### **Key Capabilities**

Enterprise program leadership • Operational strategy • Portfolio management • Cross-functional integration • Systems thinking • Execution • Consultative problem solving • Stakeholder influence • Human-centered problem solving • Measurement and analytics • Continuous improvement • Organizational change

### **Why St. Jude**

At St. Jude, operational excellence ultimately serves a larger purpose. The work of the Leadership Academy helps equip leaders across the institution to lead people, navigate change and advance a mission unlike any other.

As **Director of Academy Operations**, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape not only what the Leadership Academy delivers, but how it works: building the infrastructure, partnerships and operating practices that allow a small team to create meaningful impact across St. Jude.

 
 

**Minimum Education and/or Training:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Master's degree preferred.
 

 

**Minimum Experience:**

* 10+ years related experience.
* Significant experience managing large teams and building systems and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Experience translating strategic goals into operational goals and overseeing execution.
* Proven experience leading administration & operations management, driving execution, managing stakeholders, budget planning & resource mgmt.
* Prior experience in vendor contract negotiations and strategic vendor relationship management.
* Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.
 

 

**Compensation**

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $125,840 - $238,160 per year for the role of Director of Operations: St. Jude Leadership Academy.

Explore our exceptional benefits!

 
 

We are committed to a human-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI.

 
 

St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer

 
 

**No Search Firms**

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

new_roles.title: Executive Director, Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

JOB DESCRIPTION:

* The Executive Director for Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence provides executive strategic and operational leadership for the Office of Research Administration's (ORA) enterprise-wide transformation portfolio.
* Reporting to the Vice President for Research Administration, this position serves as the Vice President's primary operational deputy and leads the execution of high-priority initiatives that advance organizational effectiveness, service excellence, innovation, and measurable transformation outcomes across Emory's research enterprise.
* Leads an enterprise-wide transformation portfolio spanning research administration functions across schools, units, and Emory Healthcare, requiring university-wide change leadership and executive influence.
* Oversees a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology implementation (including the Insight grants management system), organizational redesign, shared services transformation, operational performance improvement, artificial intelligence and emerging technology strategy, and research administration training and professional development.
* Directs implementation, ongoing maintenance, and optimization of enterprise systems and tools, including Insight and LegalSifter, and ensures that technology investments support the future-state operating model.
* Co-leads implementation and ongoing review of future-state operating model, including organizational design, workflow refinement, shared services transformation, and operational performance.
* Exercises decision-making authority over implementation, configuration alignment, workflow and business process design, user acceptance, vendor management, future-state operating model alignment, and continuous refinement across pre-award, post-award, agreements, effort reporting, personnel, and compliance modules.
* Manages vendor performance (including Huron), monitors project milestones, and reports status, risks, decisions, and outcomes to the Vice President and Steering Committee.
* Holds executive accountability for realization of transformation outcomes, including organizational effectiveness, service excellence, operational efficiency, adoption, and sustained performance improvement.
* Oversees programs and enabling capabilities required for responsible AI success, including tool evaluation, procurement, implementation, governance, workforce readiness, and adoption. Manages technology evaluation, procurement, implementation, and security coordination in partnership with Emory OIT and Information Security.
* Establishes a governance framework aligned with institutional policy and applicable federal requirements, including NSPM-33, NIST, and NIH/NSF guidance, and serves as ORA's liaison to central technology and governance bodies.
* Partners to recruit and develop a professional training team for research administration, including Training Manager and Instructional Designer roles.
* Leads the design and deployment of a scalable, role-based training ecosystem that includes Insight and Compass system training, process-compliance content, change enablement, and professional development for ORA and school-based research administration staff.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, health administration, or a related field from an accredited institution and eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in related research administration experience, including a minimum of five years of experience in a management role with direct supervisory responsibility.
* Master's degree (MBA, MPA, MHA, MS, or related discipline) strongly preferred.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Master's degree or doctoral degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with Huron's Insight platform at an R1 university or academic medical center in a project leadership or system administration capacity.
* Direct, client-side experience supporting or co-leading a management consulting engagement (EY, Huron Consulting, Deloitte, or equivalent) in a research or academic operations context.
* Experience building or leading a training, learning and development, or organizational capability function in a higher education or healthcare research environment.
* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and federal data security and research security requirements (e.g., NSPM-33, NIST SP 800-171, CUI requirements).
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent); certification preferred.
* Professional certification in one or more of the following: research administration (CRA or CPRA), project management (PMP), or change management (Prosci ADKAR / CCMP).
* Experience in a centralized or shared services research administration environment, particularly at an institution transitioning from a decentralized model.
* Familiarity with Emory University's systems, culture, and governance structure, or comparable experience at an AAU or Carnegie R1 institution.

NOTE: Position tasks are generally required to be performed in-person at an Emory University location. Remote work from home day options may be granted at department discretion. Emory reserves the right to change remote work status with notice to employee.

Additional Details: Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Emory University complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veteran's Readjustment Assistance Act, and applicable executive orders, federal and state regulations regarding nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and affirmative action (for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities). Inquiries regarding this policy should be directed to the Emory University Department of Equity and Civil Rights Compliance, 201 Dowman Drive, Administration Building, Atlanta, GA 30322. Telephone: 404-727-9867 (V) | 404-712-2049 (TDD).
 
 
Emory University is committed to ensuring equal access and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to seek a reasonable accommodation, please contact the Department of Accessibility Services at accessibility@emory.edu or call 404-727-9877 (Voice) | 404-712-2049 (TDD). We kindly ask that requests be made at least seven business days in advance to allow adequate time for coordination.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.

* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

new_roles.title: Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide a drug-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

 

**Notice to Search Firms:** *We are not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. We will not pay any placement, referral or other fees to any search firms unless we have agreed otherwise in a valid, written agreement for the specific position posted and signed by an authorized representative of Ashley Furniture Industries.*

 

***Please note this position is not eligible for current or future employment sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or at any time in the future.***

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

new_roles.title: Operational Excellence Director
new_roles.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

new_roles.title: Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.

Job area: Managerial

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**
 
In 1976, ten independent haulers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global, yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

 

**Location**: USA - Fort Worth, 9401 Hemphill St

**Division**: Solutions

**Job Posting Title**: Director, Operations

**Time Type**: Full Time

 

**SUMMARY**

The Director of Operations provides overall direction and guidance to the operational activities of the organization. Provides strategic leadership and management to Operations within a large geographic region. The Regional Director of Operations will strive to maximize growth and profitability while responsibly managing the resources of their region according to the company and client expectations and policies. Develops and implements long and short-term strategies to achieve financial and growth targets. Develops emerging talent and successors and creates a work environment that promotes the values of DSV.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for supporting the company strategy including growth and transformational initiatives.
* Develop regional strategies to align with enterprise targets.
* Ensure targets are achieved and local needs are also met.
* Plans and budgets regional financial targets.
* Responsible for ensuring results are achieved against targets.
* Ensure operational excellence within and across our core services.
* Ensures operational excellence through standardization of existing practices, risk assessment and review of key metrics.
* Provides leadership and creates an environment that fosters passion, teamwork and agility within the organization.
* Ensures initiatives are developed and executed in the selection and development of talent and creates an environment that improves associate engagement.
* Build and sustains long-term client relationships.
* Supports local, regional and global sales initiatives by partnering with key clients and delivering a high level of client focus to business initiatives.
* Plans and successfully execute start-up facilities for new business.
* Spearheads teams and partners with clients to trouble-shoot and solve existing issues or problems.
* Contributes as a key member to our sales and solutions team in winning key strategic accounts.
* Develops and implements an operations strategy tailored to our client that identifies opportunities to improve cost control and margin improvement and will lead to organic growth.
* Consistently works within a complex matrixed environment.
* Works collaboratively and establishes solid business relationships with supporting departments including but not limited to: Human Resources, Sales, and Finance.
 

**OTHER DUTIES**

* Performs special projects as required
 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The Regional Director of Operations directly supervises General Managers.
* Responsible for overall management to achieve client satisfaction.
* Must interpret policies, purposes, and goals of the organization for subordinates.
* Responsible for performance management of direct reports.
* Builds bench strength by leading, developing and challenging operations teams to raise individual and collective performance levels by demonstrating and promoting discretionary effort.
 

**MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or logistics or equivalent fields is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ logistics operations management experience with big box", e-commerce or specialty retailers and at least 5 years’ experience as a regional operations leader managing multiple locations.
 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* Master’s degree preferred.
* Third-party logistics experience is preferred but not required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations

* Involvement in relevant professional organizations is desirable
 

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES**

Computer Skills

* Strong proficiency in MS Office applications is needed.
* Working knowledge of industry WMS

Language Skills

* English (reading, writing, and verbal)

Mathematical Skills

* Intermediate mathematical, accounting, and financial skills

Other Skills

* Excellent verbal, written and visual/presentation communication skills.
* Must be adept at navigating within a matrixed organizational structure.
* Results-oriented and able to work and meet timelines.
* Ability to work well under pressure and multi-task.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a complex matrix environment across multiple levels within the organization.
* Ability to motivate and inspire others to achieve.
* Ability to question and challenge existing ways of thinking.
* Experience in a “client-centric" environment with accountability for both operations metrics and client relations.
* Must excel at and enjoy teaming with members of the operations team and client representatives to trouble-shoot and solve existing problems.
* Direct experience preparing budgets and actively participating in financial reviews with a solid understanding of standard and actual cost variances
* Has led high-performing teams. Can recruit, develop and motivate superior talent
* Possess the ability to motivate and maintain effective working relationships with staff and partners.

new_roles.title: Director Field Service Operations – Southeast Region
new_roles.description:
The **Director, Field Service Operations - Southeast Region** will lead and execute the strategic and operational direction of the L/M/HV Services business across a regional footprint, with clear ownership for safety performance, quality execution, financial delivery, and disciplined project management. This leader will be responsible for P&L performance, team leadership, and customer satisfaction across aftermarket services, lifecycle programs, and project execution within the region. The role is central to driving business growth, strengthening operational controls, developing talent, and ensuring field work is planned, executed, and closed out with strong safety, quality, cost, and schedule discipline.

 

This is a **hybrid position** based out of one of our Field Service corporate offices within the **Southeast Region**. The role requires **approximately 40% travel** throughout the assigned region to support business operations, customer relationships, field service teams, and business development initiatives.

 

**Strategic & Financial Leadership**

* Define and execute the service strategy for M/HV products in alignment with regional and corporate objectives.
* Develop and lead growth plans for aftermarket services, engineering solutions, and lifecycle contracts.
* Expand and evolve service offerings (e.g., retrofits, upgrades, and maintenance agreements).
* Ownership of the service P&L for the M/HV segment, including revenue, margin, cost controls, and EBITDA for the defined area.
* Work collaboratively with the President to focus on pricing strategy, cost management, margin optimization, and budget planning for the Southeast region.

 

**Operational Excellence**

* Oversee delivery of safe, high-quality services across all active projects and accounts, while delighting the customer.
* Leverage operational tools (Salesforce, Power BI, etc.) to track KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
* Ensure efficient use of internal labor and subcontractors, oversee backlog management, inventory, receivables, and timely project execution.
* Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practice across field operations.

 

**T****eam Leadership**

* Lead, engage and motivate a diverse, multi-disciplinary team including Managers, PMs, Supervisors, Engineers, and Field Technicians.
* Champion a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, and excellence in customer service delivery through our core values.
* Develop and mentor leadership and technical talent, with a focus on building a NETA certified workforce.
* Ensure all work is performed in accordance with health and safety requirements and in compliance with state and federal regulations.
* Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, hiring strategies, and technical development programs.

 

**Customer & Commercial Engagement**

* Support President on strategic customer accounts; manage escalations and ensure satisfaction.
* Drive alignment between operations and sales to deliver on service bookings, upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and long-term agreements.
* Actively support the development of complex bids, proposals, and emergency response strategies.
* Participate in customer site visits and strategic planning meetings for projects.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 10+ years in Field Services, Power Systems, or Industrial Services with direct P&L ownership.
* Strong financial acumen and demonstrated experience managing a full P&L, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin improvement, cost control, and working capital performance.
* Proven leadership of multi-site service operations and technical field teams.
* Strong understanding of M/HV systems, NETA testing requirements, and utility/industrial service environments.
* Experience with Salesforce, project management tools, and business analytics platforms.
* Ability to travel 25-40% to support operations, team development, and customer engagement.

 

**Preferred Certifications & Skills:**

* NETA Certification or strong familiarity with NETA testing protocols.
* OSHA, NFPA 70E, or similar safety compliance certifications.
* Strong interpersonal skills and executive presence.
* Change leadership and process improvement (Lean/Six Sigma a plus).

**Where Potential Powers Progress**

At Sunbelt Solomon, we believe progress starts with people — their ideas, their expertise, and their drive to make energy work better. With more than a century of combined experience, we deliver full-lifecycle power, energy, and automation solutions across the Americas.

 

From our 40+ locations and a team of over 1,700 skilled professionals, we serve nearly every industry with the people, products, and insight needed to keep the electricity running. Our solutions span low-, medium-, and high-voltage systems, covering the complete electrical lifecycle, from design and engineering to operation, maintenance, modernization, and sustainable decommissioning. We’re known for our expertise in remanufacturing electrical equipment, including transformers and switchgear, and for providing flexible, reliable temporary power rental solutions. Through the Sunbelt Solomon family of brands, including Trinity Power, Magna IV Engineering, and Power Solutions Group, we combine deep technical field experience with advanced engineering and turnkey project delivery.

 

Together, we help customers optimize performance, extend asset life, and achieve sustainability goals while building a more resilient, efficient energy future. At our core, we’re powered by people — innovators, engineers, technicians, and problem solvers — all working together to deliver energy solutions that move industries forward.

 

**Mission, Purpose, Vision & Core Values**

In developing our mission, purpose, vision and core business values, we engaged in a thoughtful process that incorporated the combined principles of our family of companies and reflects our commitment to valuing our history and investing in our people, services, and products.

 

**Mission:** Through a culture of integrity, bold innovation, and customer-centricity we create value for our partners and team members with safe and reliable electrical power solutions and services.

**Purpose:** To enhance the lives of our team members and partners through sustainable products and services in the communities we serve.

**Vision:** To be the leading provider of customized electrical power solutions and services.

**Core Values:**

* People: The core of our success.

* Safety: It’s in our DNA.

* Strategic: We forge our own future.

* Sustainability: Industry leaders in power distribution life cycle management.

* Performance: Delivering excellence at every opportunity.

 

**Company Benefits**

Sunbelt Solomon offers a comprehensive, highly competitive benefits package to employees who meet applicable plan eligibility requirements. Benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401k with company match, life insurance and disability, paid vacation, sick time, and holiday. Temp employees are not eligible for company benefits.

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

 

**Pre-Employment Screening**

Following an offer of employment all candidates are required to complete a background check and drug screen prior to being cleared to start employment. A physical, respiratory fit test, and/or Motor Vehicle Record check may also be required based on the job responsibilities and location of the position.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston
new_roles.description:
**Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston**

Overview

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.

We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge-and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.

Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities-we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

Job Description 
Reporting to the Regional Vice President of Operations, the Sr. Club Operations Director will be responsible for maintaining Equinox Standards across an assigned market area. This leadership role demands a deep understanding of Club management, with a focus on driving sales, enhancing the member experience, and ensuring that the Equinox’s luxury image is consistently upheld. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will lead and manage a group of General Managers and will with closely to lead Club and Ancillary teams, implement strategic initiatives and hold teams accountable for delivering results. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will have a strong presence in driving membership sales, maintaining operational excellence, and fostering a culture of success, guided by our core values.

**Operations Management**

* Member experience and satisfaction
* Facilities maintenance and cleanliness
* Staff management and development
* Group fitness programming
* Personal training programs
* Compliance with safety and hygiene standards

**Financial Performance**

* Achieve revenue targets and control expenses
* Manage budgets and analyze financial reports
* Identify opportunities for growth and profitability

**Team Leadership**

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop department managers
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment
* Motivate and inspire staff to achieve goals
* Conduct performance reviews and provide feedback

**Member Engagement**

* Build relationships with members and address their needs
* Resolve member complaints and issues
* Create a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
* Brand Standards:
* Ensure adherence to Equinox brand guidelines and service standards
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and presentation

\*

* Implement marketing and promotional initiatives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Daily**

* Team Engagement - huddles, meetings, workouts
* Coaching GMs - Focusing on leadership and strategy
* Club Visit and Walk Through - 1-2 clubs/day
* 1on1 business meetings with GMs, AGMs and Regional Leaders

* Review clubs appointments - previous day activities (prospects, sales, equifits)
* Structured 1on1 GM Meetings - 30 min in person at least 2-3x/week
* Schedule Accountability - Checking schedules on arcon, verifying in person

**Monthly**

* GM & AGM development - ensuring it's happening (either directly or GM is delivering), schedule, reviews, learning

* People Pipeline - Staffing for future needs, identifying talent for growth
* Sales Strategy and Accountability - ensure systems and processes are being followed
* Alignment and collaboration with regionals - AE, Ancillary, Sales
* Attend PT Forums when applicable
* Stepping in when the GM requires support
* Full facility inspections - 2/week
* Meet with Regional leaders ancillary every other week/monthly
* Calls - RVP Regional call, Senior Club Director call, GM call

**PERFORMANCE TARGETS:**

100-110% in the following areas:

* New Sales
* Attrition
* Total Operating Revenue/Earnings
* Total Contribution/Profit

Qualifications

* 10+ years of experience in club operations, hospitality, fitness, or a related industry, with at least 3 years in a Sr. leadership role
* Proven track record of overseeing multiple clubs (units) or a high-volume club (facility)
* Strong background in upholding operational efficiency, utilizing & implementing standard operation procedures (SOPs), and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards
* Experience in facility management, including maintenance, equipment, vendor relations, and tech integrations for operational excellence
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, and cost control
* Ability to develop and implement revenue growth strategies through membership sales, service offerings, and ancillary revenue streams
* High proficiency in financial reporting, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision-making
* Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and develop high-performing teams across multiple functions of the business
* Experience in talent acquisition, performance management, and employee engagement
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive a positive culture of accountability and performance
* Understanding of member engagement strategies, retention, and delivering an exceptional member experience
* Strong commitment to member engagement scores and ability to utilize feedback and implement improvements
* Strong problem-solver and decision maker
* Internal Employees:No RODs in the last 6 months

**Pay Transparency: $150,000-160,000 annually: eligible for additional bonus opportunities**

**This role is based in the Boston market and requires regular travel within the assigned micro-market to support business needs and operational priorities.**

Additional Information 
**AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:**

* We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
* Complimentary Club membership
* Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

**Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at** ***https://careers.equinox.com/***

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.
