At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**What You Will Do**:

We are in search of a **17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief** who will be managing, reviewing, and approving Engineering Change Industrialization. The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be key team member within our 17/24K EC Industrial Team of the 17/24K Production Chief Office.

 

Reporting to the Deputy Production Chief, 17/24K EC Industrialization Associate Director, the role will be focusing on program management, industrialization of engineering changes, business process development, and detailed analysis to support program needs.

The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be instrumental in the achievement of Program milestones through alignment of Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain organizational plans and initiatives to Program and Customer priorities and commitments.

 

* Deliver executive presentations and program reporting on deliveries, risks, and industrial initiatives.
* Support communications, cross-functional alignment, industrial risk identification, and risk mitigation efforts for 17/24K programs.
* Participate in GTF PIPTs on behalf of the 17/24K programs.
* Collaborate with Mod Center, GSC, and cross-functional leaders on planning and execution of critical industrial actions to rate readiness for our programs.
* Leading continuous improvement activities to improve key processes; coordinate, organize, and lead critical industrial initiatives for engineering changes to minimize disruption to OEM and MRO operations
* Support MIPT and IPMT meetings for key engineering changes; present and align industrial content for critical customers
* Track and realign block changes for 24k program
* Champion MRL progression and productivity tasks
* Serve as the primary liaison for the Production Chiefs, ensuring effective communication and smooth execution across the PCIR process
* Partner closely with CAT 1 supplier to maintain alignment and drive successful incorporation planning
* Role involves travel up to 10%

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment OR a Master's degree and minimum 5 years experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience working in a fluctuating environment with constantly shifting priorities
* Demonstrated ability to critically assess industrial production schedules, qualification requirements and develop risk mitigations to drive successful program execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience using SAP
* Knowledge of the PCIR process
Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g. lean manufacturing, CORE, QCPC) 

 

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

**Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

**Privacy Policy and Terms:**

identity_held_roles.title: Quality Director
identity_held_roles.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital Longview, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.
 
 
The Director, Quality and Patient Safety plans, develops, implements and manages comprehensive and effective systems to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of patient services and programs in support of the organizational mission and goals. This position will work closely under the supervision of the Hospital CEO, functions as a support person in the coordination and organization of administrative processes in a high quality efficient and cost-effective manner. All duties to be done in accordance with Joint Commission, Federal and State regulations, Oceans’ Mission, policies and procedures and quality standards.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* Works with VP, Quality and Patient Safety implementing organization-wide quality programs at the hospital level.
* Facilitates the hospital Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) committee.
* Prepares an annual evaluation of the hospital QAPI plan, including process and outcomes.
* Oversees hospital-wide performance improvement (PI) projects identified through on-going data driven quality assessment.
* Coordinates the hospital’s data collection procedures and provides on-going support and education to staff regarding QAPI tools and reporting requirements; utilizes data and collaborates with leadership to set priorities and provide guidance in their development of quality improvement work plans.
* Serves as a resource to the medical staff, administrators and other staff including participation in root cause analyses, as indicated, to investigate potentially avoidable sentinel events.
* Completes assignments accurately, in a timely manner and within procedural guidelines.
* Coordinates education for QAPI principles and regulatory standards as indicated. Conducts training for staff.

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for Aquestive. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at Aquestive (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by Aquestive, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout Aquestive.
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by colleagues assigned to this position. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Aquestive reserves the right to make changes to the job description whenever necessary.

As part of Aquestive’s employment process, final candidate will be required to complete a drug test and background check prior to employment commencing. 
**Please Note:**
Aquestive is a drug-free workplace and has a drug free workplace policy in place.

Aquestive provides equal employment opportunities to all colleagues and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

The Company is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this job in certain states and cities within the United States. Final determinations with respect to salary will take into account a number of factors, which may include, but not be limited to the primary work location and the chosen candidate’s relevant skills, experience, and education.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Quality - Yancey Engineered Solutions
identity_held_roles.description:
**Who We Are**
**From Georgia. For Georgia.**
Since 1914 Yancey Bros. Co. has proudly served as the authorized Caterpillar equipment dealer for Georgia, providing our customers with the highest quality sales, parts and service. From Caterpillar heavy and compact construction equipment to on-highway trucks, we remain committed to learning more about our customers, offering equipment and support to keep up with their changing needs. This all starts with our greatest asset…our employees.
 
 
**What You Will Be Doing**
The Director of Quality plays a critical leadership role in enabling scalable growth by ensuring consistent manufacturing quality across all facilities. Through standardization, continuous improvement, and strong cross-functional collaboration, this leader will help reduce waste, improve operational efficiency, strengthen customer confidence, and establish a culture where quality is embedded in every aspect of the business.
 
 
The Director of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and leading the company's enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS) across multiple manufacturing facilities. This role ensures consistent quality standards, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and fosters a culture of quality throughout the organization. The Director of Quality partners closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, and Customer Service to ensure products meet or exceed customer expectations while supporting operational excellence, efficiency, and business growth.
 
 
This position requires a strategic leader capable of standardizing quality processes across multiple manufacturing operations including contract vendors, while maintaining a strong presence on the production floor and with customers.
 
 
**Main Duties And Responsibilities**

* Quality Strategy & Leadership
* Develop and execute the company's quality strategy aligned with organizational goals and growth initiatives.
* Establish standardized quality systems, procedures, and metrics across all manufacturing facilities.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Build a culture where quality is viewed as a shared responsibility throughout the organization.
* Mentor and develop quality managers and quality personnel across all locations.
* Establish clear accountability through performance metrics and regular operational reviews.
* Develop and monitor quality inspection audits throughout all facilities.
* Manufacturing Quality
* Ensure consistent execution of quality standards throughout fabrication, welding, coating, assembly, and final inspection processes.
* Standardize inspection methods, documentation, work instructions, and acceptance criteria across facilities.
* Implement robust process controls to reduce variation and improve first-pass yield.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) processes using structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Monitor production quality metrics and implement initiatives that reduce defects, waste, and rework.
* Customer Quality
* Lead investigations and resolution of customer complaints and warranty issues.
* Develop systems that proactively identify trends and prevent recurring customer issues.
* Establish customer quality scorecards and regularly communicate performance metrics.
* Participate in customer audits and quality reviews as required.
* Supplier Quality
* Develop supplier quality standards and qualification processes.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and corrective action processes.
* Partner with Supply Chain to improve incoming material quality and supplier performance.
* Conduct supplier audits when necessary.
* Continuous Improvement
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process improvement and waste reduction.
* Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that improve quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop standardized best practices and ensure successful implementation across all facilities.
* Quality Systems & Compliance
* Maintain compliance with applicable industry standards, customer requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Develop standardized documentation, policies, procedures, and audit systems.
* Lead internal audit programs.
* Ensure accurate documentation of quality records and performance metrics.
* Performance Management
* Develop and monitor quality KPIs, including:
* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* Rework
* Customer Complaints
* Warranty Performance
* Corrective Action Closure
* Supplier Quality Performance
* Present quality performance and improvement initiatives to executive leadership.

**Additional Skills/Responsibilities**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Exceptional leadership and team development skills
* Strong communication and presentation abilities
* Ability to influence across multiple departments and locations
* High level of accountability and integrity
* Data-driven decision making
* Customer-focused mindset
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

**Who We Are Looking For**
To be successful in this position you should be organized and have effective decision-making skills. You should possess a strong leadership skills and maintain a deep understanding of production and operational processes. The ability to work in a team environment is essential to this position as well.
 
 
**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Quality Management, or related field.
* Experience
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing quality experience.
* 5+ years in a multi-site quality leadership role preferred.
* Experience in metal fabrication, welding, powder coating/painting, or industrial manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Experience implementing enterprise Quality Management Systems across multiple facilities.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Certifications/Technical Competencies**

* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification
* Lean Manufacturing certification
* Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* Statistical Process Control (SPC)
* Root Cause Analysis (8D, A3, Fishbone, 5 Whys)
* Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA)
* Lean Manufacturing
* Six Sigma
* Data analysis and reporting
* Manufacturing ERP and quality management software
* Microsoft Office Suite

**Values**
At Yancey Bros. Co, we are always looking to add people to our team who share our core values:
 
 

* Safety: We value the lives and health of our team and customers above all else.
* Integrity: We are ethical and trustworthy, demonstrate respect for others, and communicate truthfully and promptly.
* Teamwork: We work as one across our organization for the benefit of our customers.
* Excellence: We strive to be the best, continuously improving our customers’ experience and the solutions we provide.
* Sense of Urgency: We respond quickly to customer needs and hold ourselves accountable for results.

**Ideal Candidates Will Demonstrate The Following Values**

* Acting in a safe manner
* Exhibiting honesty and integrity
* Acting in a fair and ethical manner
* Team mentality
* Delivering quality results
* Embraces change / improvement
* Exhibiting superior customer service skills
* Exhibiting pride and ownership
* Working with a sense of urgency
* Exhibiting a winning attitude

**What We Offer**
Yancey Bros Co offers a full benefits package that includes aggressive compensation levels, technician tool allowances, full medical, vision and dental coverage, employee wellness programs, paid vacations and more.
 
 
**Competitive Pay Structure**

* Competitive Pay
* Individual Bonus Opportunities Available
* Technician Tool Allowance
* 401k Plan Strong Company Match
* Employee Profit Sharing
* Financial Wellness Coaching

**Employee Wellness Program**

* Medical, Vision, Dental Insurance
* Prescription Drug Coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Short & Long Term Disability
* Group Life Insurance

**Personal Time Off**

* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave

**Career Development**

* Tuition Reimbursement
* Ongoing Training
* Advancement Opportunities

identity_held_roles.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director of Quality will be responsible for the execution of Business and Corporate Quality strategies of the assigned divisions. Aligned with the VP of Quality and the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), this role will bear an immediate and significant impact on the ongoing and continued success of RealTruck as quality is a cornerstone of our brands’ equity and strength, providing a competitive edge that fuels the company's overall growth.
 
 
With the primary focus on deploying RealTruck Quality Management Systems (QMS), improving customer satisfaction, and reducing Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), the Director will drive and optimize all processes to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. This position will support a culture of high performance through effective relationships and collaboration/alignment across functions, ensuring accountability that policies and procedures are followed.
 
 
The Director of Quality will provide support, leading the deployment of RealTruck QMS and the improvement of processes to achieve the assigned targets. This position will provide expertise helping implement processes and productivity improvements that foster a quality culture within the organization.
 
 
**Core Functions**

* Drive a culture of Quality Excellence aligned with RealTruck Quality Strategy.
* Support in creating Quality Strategy, process, and organization.
* Support creation and implementation of a company-wide culture and methodologies to drive quality processes to help best respond to the various stakeholders needs.
* Understand and anticipate needs of key customers to ensure quality systems meet or exceed their standards. Ensure divisions are set to exceed customer expectations.
* Monitor quality trends, confer with key customers to define quality issues, communicate issues to cross-functional management teams, and achieve alignment regarding resolution strategies.
* Assist in corrective action and investigations, and overall management at the site level to ensure high standard of investigation and problem solving.
* Identify recurring trouble spots by maintaining ongoing connections, contact and visibility. Install the right systems and culture to create a structured and disciplined quality approach while building the proper processes with internal and external partners.
* Ensure Quality metrics are properly deployed and tracked at Division level. Support setting up and achieve targets as per defined Strategy.
* Support local teams and corporate functions in improving Warranty, COPQ, Scrap, and other Quality related metrics.
* Support the implementation of one corporate quality manual for each facility to use for continuity and consistency. Provide support, when necessary, regarding corrective and preventive actions at facilities.

**Qualifications & Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree preferred.
* 7+ years of experience in Quality Systems Engineering within a manufacturing environment required.
* 5+ years of effective team leadership required.
* Proven track record of driving quality improvements over time.
* Experience in the automotive industry that demonstrates working knowledge for quality requirements, protocols and automotive customer’s expectations is desired.

**Required Licenses**

* Lean/Six Sigma green belt certification or equivalent work experience or company certification preferable.

**Skills, Abilities, And Knowledge**

* Thorough knowledge of quality assurance methods and improvement tools.
* Advanced Product Quality Planning – Ability to lead the technical quality planning and ensures customer satisfaction through structured and measurable processes as defined by industry standards.
* Dimensional Metrology – Ability to apply dimensional measurement science in the development and application of measurement/inspection processes that deliver capable measurement results, supporting design validation and conformity assessment meeting regulatory, customer and product requirements.
* Quality System Management – Ability to guide in the practice and application of quality management system standards required by international certification bodies, industry-specific regulatory authorities, and customer's contractually specified requirements.
* Ability to balance team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.
* Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Generates suggestions for improving work; Develops innovative approaches and ideas.
* Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
* Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem-solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data-driven business decisions.
* Knowledgeable in Mini- Tab preferred.
* Expert level Excel skills.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Travel**

* Approximately 30% (Maybe higher during certain periods).

* Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures.

* Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
* Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings.

**Supervisor Responsibilities**

* Manager+: Plans, organizes, evaluates, and directs the employees within the department function. Has direct reports. This position delegates authority to carry out work of a unit to subordinate supervisors or managers.

**Physical Requirements**

* This position is subject to Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involved sitting most of the time. Walking and standing are required only occasionally.

**Physical Activities**

* This position is subject to the following physical activities: talking and hearing.

**Visual Acuity**

* The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; expansive reading; visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines (including inspection); using measurement devices; and/or assembly of fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.

**Working Conditions**

* This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment

At RealTruck, we take care of our people—because they drive our success. Enjoy great benefits like medical, dental, and vision coverage, company-paid life insurance and disability, and a 401(k) with company match (eligible the first of the month after you start). Need balance? We’ve got wellbeing days and parental leave. Want to grow? Take advantage of educational reimbursement. Plus, earn referral bonuses and score exclusive employee discounts on RealTruck products. Great benefits. Great people. Even better careers.
 
 
RealTruck is the premier manufacturer and digital destination of accessories for truck, Jeep®, Bronco® and off-road enthusiasts around the world. Globally headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan, RealTruck’s 6,000+ associates operate from 35+ facilities across four continents. RealTruck’s industry leading product portfolio, which includes the Husky Liners total vehicle protection brand, boasts over 1,000 patents and pending applications. The company’s omni-channel retail approach delivers a seamless consumer experience online at RealTruck.com, as well as through its 12,000+ dealer network and automotive (OEM) partnerships.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.
 
 
This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation’s space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.
 
 
As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead the Quality organization across our Corona and South El Monte sites, ensuring a robust Quality Management System (QMS) and driving measurable improvements in product and process quality. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer expectations into clear quality strategies, resolve systemic issues, and build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and quality ownership.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Leads the Quality Assurance organization across both sites, managing staffing, development, performance, and accountability.
* Provides clear direction and establishes priorities, metrics, and expectations for quality performance.
* Develops and executes Quality Improvement Plans informed by customer feedback, audit findings, nonconformances, and performance trends.
* Serves as the primary Voice of the Customer (VOC) focal point for quality matters and converts customer concerns into internal improvement actions.
* Leads root cause and corrective action (CAPA/RCCA) activities, ensuring effective containment, corrective action, verification, and timely closure.
* Facilitates Corrective Action Board (CAB) meetings, driving cross-functional ownership of actions and tracking progress to closure.
* Identifies and leads continuous improvement projects to improve product quality, process capability, first-pass yield, and reduce defects and rework.
* Partners with Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to address systemic defects and strengthen process controls.
* Oversees supplier approval, auditing, monitoring, and corrective actions to maintain supplier quality performance.
* Manages document change control, MRB (material review board) activities, and internal audits to ensure compliance with the QMS and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in work experience, American Society for Quality (ASQ) training, or certification.
* Minimum five years of experience in quality control or quality assurance within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum five years of experience implementing or managing ISO Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Demonstrated experience leading root cause analysis, corrective action, and preventive action (CAPA/RCCA) processes.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving corrective actions to closure.
* Experience facilitating corrective action reviews, quality boards, or similar cross-functional forums.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D.
* Experience with customer and supplier audits.
* Familiarity with aerospace and defense manufacturing processes, customer specifications, and quality requirements.
* Ability to conduct formal training on quality and customer requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to use data to identify trends and drive improvement.
* Ability to lead and develop a Quality organization and build strong cross-functional relationships.
* Knowledge of QMS reporting, record keeping, and quality management processes.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Salary Range
 
 
$125,000 - $175,000 USD
 
 
Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Join Our Relentless Pursuit of Excellence**

At
**Singer Vehicle Design**
, we believe
*Everything is Important.*
That’s why every nut, bolt, stitch, and finish matters when we restore and reimagine Porsche 911s into some of the most beautiful and respected cars in the world.

We’re looking for a
**Director of Quality**
to bring their leadership, precision, and problem-solving skills to our team in
**Torrance, CA**
. If you share our passion for beautiful cars, thrive on details, and want to be part of something extraordinary, this is your chance.

**Why You’ll Love This Role:**

* You will lead the US Quality team and work to further develop and implement the Quality strategy in conjunction with our UK Quality team for Singer vehicle production in manner that demonstrates, “Everything is Important”
* You will oversee all aspects of the Singer Quality Department including design and production quality engineering, continuous improvement, and incoming and final inspection functions in an Automotive manufacturing environment

**What You’ll Do:**

* Manage a team of Quality Engineers and Quality Inspectors
* Develop Key Performance Indicators and implement strategies to achieve company and department’s objectives
* Create and implement quality management system and company’s overall culture of continuous improvement aligned with strategic business development, growth plans, and UK Operations
* Work with Procurement, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Customer Experience, and Warranty personnel in US and UK to support the resolution of internal and external quality issues
* Work with manufacturing departments to improve quality performance and compliance to Singer’s requirements
* Create, implement, and manage the Production MRB process
* Manage resolution of systemic issues in a timely/professional manner and ensure root cause and corrective actions are completed to drive effective process improvements
* Develop and analyze data and product/process performance to recommend and implement improvements in targeted areas of the organization
* Establish and implement metrics for monitoring system effectiveness and to enable other functional managers and Quality team members to make sound quality decisions regarding product, customer, regulatory, and systems quality
* Champion continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies across the business
* Manage production and quality Record Retention and Management process

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or relevant degree
* Ten (10) plus years of experience in Quality Functions in an automotive or similar manufacturing environment
* Five (5) plus years in supervisory/managerial role
* Five (5) plus years in Quality Engineering role
* Experience with Pareto Analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving competency (Root Cause, Corrective Action and Continuous Improvement, and 8D).
* Experience implementing Quality Management Systems
* AS9100/ISO Audit experience
* Bonus points for ASQ Certificate in Quality Leadership, Quality Audit, Quality Engineering or Six Sigma
* Bonus points for experience with implementing ERP/MRP systems
* Bonus points for prior experience in a rapid growth environment

**Location & Schedule:**

This position is onsite in Torrance, CA. The hours are Monday – Friday 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM

**What We Offer - Benefits Driven by You:**

The starting pay range for this position is between $169,037.00 - $225,386.00 per year plus bonus. Actual compensation will be determined by skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Our mantra
*Everything is Important*
guides us every day, so naturally we also believe
*Everyone is Important*
. Our benefits and perks are thoughtfully curated to invest in the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team both inside and outside the shop.

Health & Wellness

* 80% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and family with choices for HMO & PPO plans
* Tax-free savings options via HSA and FSA, including employer HSA contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage

Time Off & Flexibility

* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 13 paid holidays annually, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s

Financial Benefits

* Annual bonus plan
* 401(k) with company match
* Annual merit increases following performance reviews (when eligible)
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement

Perks & Extras

* Free snacks! (monthly snack stipend at our mini-mart)
* “Working Advantage” employee discount program for travel, entertainment, amusement parks, and more
* Tools provided for technicians
* Team events and company gatherings throughout the year
* Discounted pet insurance through MetLife
* Employee-led clubs based on interest: books, movies and (of course) cars!
* Access to exclusive Singer-branded merch!

Growth & Development

* Annual performance reviews to provide feedback and aid employee development
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Access to Singer's learning platform (Singer Learn) containing over 115,000 courses on a wide variety of topics - coming soon!
* Transparent leadership communication through quarterly town halls

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to building a team that includes individuals from different cultural backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, ages, sexual orientation, and physical abilities, reflecting the diversity of the communities where we work and live.

**Do you want to Reimagine your career? Apply now and join us!**

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Quality Management
identity_held_roles.description:
**Director, Quality ManagementCompany Overview**
At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.
 
 
****Role Overview****
Mitsubishi Power is hiring a Director, Quality Management in the Savannah Machinery Works location. The Quality Director is the senior site quality leader and is accountable for leading quality assurance, quality control, inspection, metrology, non-destructive examination (NDE), customer quality and Quality Management System activities. The role ensures that products and services meet applicable customer, contractual, regulatory and Mitsubishi Power requirements.
 
 
This leader partners with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Maintenance and Commercial teams to strengthen customer confidence, improve first-time quality, reduce quality escapes and quality-related disruption, and support safe, reliable growth. The role is expected to advance a prevention-focused quality culture by using technology, data, technical expertise and cross-functional resources to identify, control and mitigate quality risk before defects occur.
 
 
****Key Responsibilities****

* Demonstrates our core competencies: Action oriented, change champion, customer-focused, developing self & others, and ownership.
* Champion a culture where quality is built into every process and owned at all levels of the organization.
* Provide strategic leadership to prevent defects, reduce quality risks, and enhance customer satisfaction through disciplined execution and data-driven decision making.
* Drive continuous improvement of key quality performance metrics, including:

+ Customer and internal quality escapes
+ First-Time Quality (FTQ) and process capability
+ Cost of Quality (COQ), scrap, and rework
+ On-time completion of inspections, hold points, and First Article Inspections (FAIs)
+ Corrective action closure, effectiveness, and sustainability
+ Audit performance, findings reduction, and timely closure
+ Quality-related schedule adherence and operational performance
+ Preventive controls, risk mitigation, and defect prevention
+ Adoption and effectiveness of digital quality systems, reporting tools, and dashboards
+ Technical competency, cross-training, workforce development, and succession planning

* Leverage people, processes, technology, and analytics to improve quality performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support safe, reliable business growth.
* Lead the development of a high-performing quality team through coaching, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Ensure quality objectives are aligned with business priorities while maintaining independent technical judgment and regulatory compliance.

****Requirements****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology or a related technical field. Advanced degree in Engineering, Business or a related field preferred.
* At least 8 years of progressive quality experience in a complex manufacturing, repair, power generation, aerospace, energy or comparable industrial environment.
* At least 5 years of experience leading quality professionals, technical specialists or multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated experience with customer-facing quality leadership, quality systems, audits, nonconformance management, root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Demonstrated ability to use quality data, digital tools and structured risk methods to prevent defects and improve process performance.
* Experience leading cross-functional change and sustaining measurable improvements.
* ASQ certification such as Certified Quality Engineer, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence or Certified Quality Auditor.
* Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Experience with NDE, metrology, heavy machining, rotating equipment, turbine component manufacturing, assembly or repair operations.
* Experience implementing digital quality management, analytics, automated inspection or predictive quality solutions.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis and must not require employer immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

****Why Should You Apply?****

* Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
* Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities.
* Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* Committed to quality products and services.
* Great working environment and culture.
* Employee Appreciation Programs and Events.

Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.
 
 
#QCJ

identity_held_roles.description:
**Description**
This position leads all plant operations for a70+ employee, 2 shift, manufacturing site. This leader ensures day-to-day operations are delivered with the aligned objectives of safety-first mindset, customer satisfaction along with growing and developing the leaders within the facility. This position also plays a critical role in developing and executing capital project plans for the facility to enable continuous improvement and growth in market share.
 
 
This full-time position reports directly to region General Manager and is located at Liberty Packaging’s manufacturing plant in Houston, Texas
 
 
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Directly lead and supervise a team of direct reports to deliver major site functions across manufacturing, shipping, maintenance, and scheduling.
* Own end-to-end performance for the facility to meet KPIs in the areas of Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery. Establish, measure, and monitor performance across facility and root cause performance issues. Develop and deploy plans to drive improvements in manufacturing processes to ensure superior product quality, reduced cycle times, lead times, and minimize overall manufacturing costs.
* Provide day-to-day leadership for manufacturing team decision-making in the areas of production, labor, material costs, design, and production scheduling.
* In partnership with Continuous Improvement function, guide leaders and front-line staff through the identification and deployment of continuous improvement initiatives with an impact on key performance indicators.
* Ensure the right talent and capabilities are in place to meet strategic objectives; accountable for establishing goals, managing performance, and developing teams to ensure short- and long-range objectives are achieved
* Establish a two-way communication & engagement culture to ensure all plant employees are clear on plant performance and connection to business performance, including KPIs.
* Lead key change initiatives across the plant in partnership with regional and functional support systems (e.g., continuous improvement, engineering, human resources, sales, etc.)
* Lead the successful identification, business case design, and execution of capital projects in partnership with functional teams and executive leadership. Ensure multi-year capital plans support market growth and customer delivery
* Ensure employee relations stay connected with open and continuous dialogue
* Develop and grow community engagement presence by representing plant locally in key activities and through execution of frequent employee and community engagement activities
* Own direct P&L responsibility for plant site
* Provide leadership by connecting and being visible to all three shifts daily
* Other duties, as assigned

**Required Education, Experience And Skills**

* Bachelors’ degree and 7+ years manufacturing experience OR 10+ years manufacturing industry experience in lieu of education
* 5+ years people leadership experience
* Experience analyzing downtime, production, and financial variance trends, and identifying actions to deliver expected performance
* Previous experience developing and managing a budget, forecasting, and monitoring results
* Experience with identifying and executing capital projects to drive improvement against KPIs
* Demonstrated experience with organizational effectiveness, operations management, and a proven track record of achieving results
* Experience developing and presenting information to multiple levels of the organization from front-line to executive leadership
* Superior time management, attention to detail, verbal and written communication skills, decision-making, and organization skills
* Excellent computer skills required, including Microsoft Word and Excel skills.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit

**Preferred Education, Experience And Skills**

* Previous experience with Amtech / CTI or Kiwi
* Previous experience with ERP systems
* Previous experience in corrugated or paper manufacturing
* Lean and / or Continuous Improvement certifications
* Bilingual English / Spanish

**Compensation & Benefits**
The starting base salary range for this position is $110,078 - $137,598 per year plus eligibility in annual bonus program. The compensation posted is the anticipated pay for the position at the time of the posting. We may pay above or below posted amount based on several factors, including, but not limited to education and/or certifications, skills, experience, or work location. Some positions may qualify for additional compensation in the form of bonuses or deferred compensation options.
 
 
At LDI, we are pleased to provide employees with a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision insurance options; paid time off; 10 paid holidays; 401(k) plus company matching and annual discretionary profit sharing; flexible spending and health savings account options; life and disability insurance; tuition assistance; wellness and mental health resources, and financial advising services. Eligibility in benefit programs is based on hours worked per week.
 
 
**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
 

* Regular sitting, standing, and walking throughout the day to accomplish tasks
* Manual and finger dexterity used regularly with some repetitive finger motions
* Ability to work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time
* Specific vision abilities include close and distance vision; able to identify colors, small letters, and numbers; hand/eye coordination, depth perception and able to adjust focus
* Hearing and speaking
* Other conditions may include frequent reaching, stretching, pushing, pulling, pinching, grasping, and gripping.

**About Our Company**
Comprised of multiple companies with headquarters in New Hope, Minnesota, Liberty Diversified International (LDI) is a privately held company employing more than 1,900 individuals across our manufacturing facilities, production facilities and core business operations in Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois, Mississippi, Texas, Arizona, Virginia, California, and Mexico. With deep roots in the corrugated box manufacturing industry, we operate in the core markets of paper, packaging, workplace products, corrugated plastics and building products.
 
 
Since 1918, our values – Caring, Innovation, Trust and Excellence – have guided our day-to-day activities. We believe that when our employees are aligned with these values, we create superior service and solutions for our customers. The LDI family of companies includes Liberty Packaging, Liberty Paper, Liberty Plastics (Custom Solutions and Quarrix Building Products) and Safco.
 
 
Liberty Diversified International is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.
 
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Atlas Roofing Corporation,**
a privately owned company established in 1982, is an international and multi-divisional manufacturer of roofing, sheathing, facer, and insulation product solutions.
 
 
**Atlas Molded Products is seeking a Plant Manager for the Murray, Utah Facility.**
**Plant Manager Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for all safety, product quality, company culture/values, operational performance, environmental health and safety compliance and all local, state, and federal standards.
* Coordinate all aspects of plant operations through plant leadership to ensure the site meets or exceeds the key performance indicators for safety, quality, and service while minimizing cost, inventory, and waste.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries in line with corporate guidance.
* Serve as plant champion for safety and quality programs and initiatives. Ensure a safe work environment through strict adherence to Atlas’ safety policies and procedures with focus on developing a zero-injury culture.
* Achieve manufacturing profit objectives to meet quality and delivery requirements (Customer Service) at the lowest overall cost.
* Support Engineering with product improvements, new product development, and testing.
* Manage capital equipment selection, acquisition, and implementation, manufacturing budget and long-range planning, preparation, and facility maintenance and enhancements.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the workplace.
* Responsible for selection of development of direct reports and creating an atmosphere of career development within the facility.
* Establish and maintain clear and measurable expectations for each employee to build ownership within the team.
* Complete all administrative requirements (monthly reports, manufacturing reports and analysis, etc.)

**Plant Manager Experience**

* Ten years of progressive experience in manufacturing management experience required.
* 5+ years direct supervisory experience, including staff development and planning responsibility.
* 5+ years’ experience engaging employees and developing a strong safety culture.
* Experience with business financial statements, budgetary processes, and cost control.
* Proven track record of developing, leading, and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience in capital investment planning and program management.
* Experience with Environmental, Health and Safety regulatory compliance.

**Plant Manager Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* An ability to balance and achieve positive results in the areas of safety, quality, productivity, cost, and employee relations.
* A demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Analytic skills to effectively evaluate business proposals and analyze process data.
* Ability to multi-task effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient with MS Office and experienced with manufacturing ERP systems.
* Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours if needed per business needs.

**Plant Manager Education, Licenses & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Plant Manager Additional Information**

* Must be able to tolerate industrial/manufacturing environment to include variations in temperature from extreme cold to extreme heat; wet and/or humid conditions; dust/fumes/chemical exposure; and noise intensity. Personal protective equipment required.

**Total Compensation**

* Atlas Molded Products offers a competitive compensation and vacation/holiday package as well as a comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D/LTD insurance, 401k and Medical & Dependent Care Spending Accounts.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering
identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering is a hands-on leadership role and the process authority for how Butcher Power Products’ switchboard and switchgear products are built. The person in this role must be the subject-matter expert who can also do the work — capable of designing and improving manufacturing processes and line layouts, building routings and process documentation, and personally leading process and PFMEA reviews — so they can teach and develop the manufacturing engineering team and set the standard for process quality. This role owns how products are built rather than what is designed; however, deep familiarity with the product and the production floor is essential. The Director must understand the design intent released by Product Engineering and the realities of the floor in order to engineer processes that are efficient, repeatable, and capable. This role works hand in hand with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process, partners with Quality on process controls, and supports Production and Planning rather than owning them.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Process Engineering: Personally design, document, and improve the manufacturing processes, routings, work instructions, and line layouts that build the product. This is a working role: the successful candidate stays actively engaged in process design and technical problem-solving alongside the team rather than delegating all hands-on work.
* Process Authority & Technical Review: Lead, critique, and approve the team’s process designs, routings, PFMEAs, and control plans; set and enforce the standard for process quality, capability, and engineering rigor through formal process reviews.
* Mentorship & Teaching: Coach, train, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process design, tooling, DFM/DFA, Lean and Six Sigma, time studies, and structured problem-solving, raising the technical capability of the whole team.
* Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the manufacturing engineering team, including hiring, development, workload balancing, priorities, and performance.
* Process Strategy & Standardization: Own manufacturing process strategy and standardization across product lines, and define the tooling and capital equipment roadmap.
* Product Engineering Partnership (DFM): Work closely and continuously with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process — provide manufacturability and assembly feedback at design reviews before release, jointly resolve producibility issues, and ensure released designs transition cleanly into production.
* Process Controls & Quality Partnership: Own the manufacturing side of PFMEAs and control plans in partnership with Quality Engineering; ensure processes are capable, controlled, and continuously monitored.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen across the function to improve throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost.
* Capital, Tooling & Automation: Plan and justify capital equipment, tooling, and automation investments, and provide financial management of the manufacturing engineering capital and tooling budgets.
* New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the process side of NPI — develop and validate the processes, tooling, and routings that bring newly released designs into production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Project Management, and Product Engineering on capacity, scheduling, and material flow, supporting these functions rather than owning them.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes across the function comply with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including UL 891, NEC, and ANSI.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 8+ years of progressive process engineering (or directly related) experience, including significant time spent personally developing and improving manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for process documentation, line layouts, and reviews; the ability to design tooling and fixtures in CAD is a plus.
* Strong proficiency developing routings, work instructions, process documentation, and process controls.
* Proven ability to lead formal process and PFMEA reviews and to mentor and train engineers and technicians.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a manufacturing engineering team.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability (Cpk).
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of the products being built and of how design intent translates into manufacturing process — sufficient product familiarity to engineer the right processes.
* Working knowledge of UL 891 and related standards (NEC, ANSI) as they affect manufacturing processes.
* Experience planning and justifying capital equipment and tooling investments, including financial management of budgets.
* Hands-on fabrication and machining experience is a plus.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 8D or A3 is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on manufacturing process design and improvement (CAD)
* Process authority and engineering quality standards
* Technical mentoring, teaching, and team development
* Close partnership with Product Engineering (DFM)
* Process strategy, standardization, and tooling roadmap
* Design-for-manufacturability partnership
* Process controls, PFMEA, and capability
* Continuous improvement and Lean/Six Sigma
* Capital planning, automation, and financial management
* New product introduction (process side)
* Cross-functional collaboration and communication

identity_held_roles.description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.

**More Than a Job: A Mission**

We seek a visionary leader to drive process and manufacturing excellence, designing and implementing advanced solutions that elevate operational performance. Join dedicated teams committed to transforming rail mobility, where your leadership shapes the future and leaves a lasting legacy.

**Your Role, Your Impact**

* Lead scalable process improvements to optimize manufacturing efficiency and support growth.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration between engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Ensure reliability and compliance in manufacturing operations through robust systems.
* Champion innovation by introducing new technologies and methodologies.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the site.

You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology.

**What You Bring**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or related field**
 .
* **Extensive manufacturing (industrial) engineering experience (ideally minimum 8-10 years), including proven leadership responsibilities**
 .
* Experience in working with an ERP (such as SAP) for Bill of Materials, Routings, Configuration follow-up.
* Working knowledge of Quality and Health & Safety standards and systems.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, process optimization, and industrial automation.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, regulatory standards, and operational excellence.
* Proven leadership, strategic thinking, and ability to inspire high-performing teams.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Achievement of delivery timelines and strategic manufacturing goals.
* Effective collaboration and leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
* Reduction in defects, increased efficiency, and proactive troubleshooting.

**Alstom, A Great Place to Grow**

* Work with cutting-edge technology and drive strategic vision.
* Make a global impact from our West Mifflin office.
* Advance your career through continuous learning and development.

Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Engineering – Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS / PCBA)
identity_held_roles.description:
**Location:**
Seymour, CT

**Position Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Engineering & Document Control

**Industry:**
Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) / Contract Manufacturing

**Position Overview**

The Director of Engineering – Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS / PCBA) provides strategic and operational leadership across the Engineering and Document Control organizations. This executive technical role develops advanced engineering capabilities, spearheads process and capital technology investments, directs New Product Introduction (NPI), and collaborates closely with tier-one customers and suppliers. Partnering across Operations, Quality, Program Management, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership, the Director ensures all engineering practices drive best-in-class quality, delivery, productivity, unit economics, and client satisfaction.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development:**

 + Direct Engineering and Document Control departments, establishing priorities, deploying technical resources, and driving on-time deliverable execution.
 + Mentor, coach, and upskill engineering personnel to build technical depth, personal accountability, and collaborative cross-functional relationships.
 + Define and maintain engineering standards, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and operational KPIs supporting safety, quality, yield, and throughput.
 + Forecast departmental resource demands, including technical staffing, professional training, software tools, and capital equipment.
 + Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and root-cause problem solving utilizing Lean / Six Sigma frameworks.
* **Technology Strategy & Capital Roadmap:**

 + Formulate and maintain an engineering technology roadmap aligned with organizational growth objectives, customer technology roadmaps, and emerging industry trends.
 + Benchmark internal manufacturing capabilities against market needs; recommend strategic investments in advanced equipment, software platforms, and automation.
 + Evaluate disruptive manufacturing technologies, identifying opportunities, implementation hurdles, and mitigation plans.
 + Direct the evaluation, procurement, qualification, and integration of high-precision PCBA manufacturing and test equipment.
 + Maintain expert command over SMT assembly, selective and wave soldering, box-build integration, high-level assemblies (HLA), and functional test architectures.
* **Customer Engineering & Business Development Support:**

 + Serve as the senior technical authority for existing and prospective customers, interfacing directly with client engineering teams to review designs and process capabilities.
 + Partner with Business Development and Program Management to assess customer fit, risk profiles, and project feasibility.
 + Provide engineering assessments for quotation packages, including DFM/DFT analysis, tooling requirements, process routing, cycle times, and technical risk factors.
 + Guide Design-for-Manufacturability (DFM) and Design-for-Test (DFT) reviews to optimize yield, reliability, and assembly costs.
* **New Product Introduction (NPI) & Document Control:**

 + Steer engineering participation across the complete NPI lifecycle from quoting through full-scale production ramp, ensuring seamless transition into manufacturing.
 + Oversee manufacturing process documentation, stencils, fixture design, machine programming, and work instructions for complex and quick-turn assemblies.
 + Oversee engineering component engineering, including regulatory declarations, obsolescence management, and product lifecycle health.
 + Ensure Document Control delivers rigorous, audit-ready, and revision-controlled documentation meeting internal, customer, and regulatory standards.
* **Operational & Floor Engineering Support:**

 + Provide escalation leadership and troubleshooting support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Process Engineering teams on complex production disruptions.
 + Direct defect analysis reviews, 8D root-cause investigations, and corrective action implementations for recurring or critical line issues.
 + Lead validation planning, IQ/OQ/PQ execution, and engineering change order (ECO) management.
 + Ensure technical processes maintain strict alignment with ISO, aerospace, defense, and medical regulatory standards.

**Qualifications & Experience Requirements**

* **Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (or an equivalent combination of education and direct industry experience).
* **Industry Experience:**

 + Minimum 10+ years of progressive engineering experience within the Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) / contract manufacturing industry.
 + At least 5+ years dedicated to leading New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing process development.
 + Demonstrated track record leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams in a high-reliability SMT / PCBA environment.
 + Background in highly regulated sectors (e.g., Aerospace & Defense, Medical Devices, High-Reliability Industrial).
* **Technical & Process Expertise:**

 + Deep technical command of SMT equipment and line processes: solder paste printing, SPI, high-speed pick-and-place, reflow profiling, AOI, automated X-ray (AXI), wave/selective solder, and rework.
 + Proven experience with DFM/DFT methodologies, tooling/stencil design, component defect analysis, and testing strategies (ICT, Flying Probe, Functional).
 + Working knowledge of IPC and J-STD quality standards (IPC-A-610 Class 1–3, J-STD-001); formal IPC certifications preferred.
 + Hands-on familiarity with PCB design and CAD/CAM software (Valor, Cadence, CAM350, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent).
* **Continuous Improvement & Business Acumen:**

 + Demonstrated success championing Lean / Six Sigma implementations and organizational change; Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.
 + Solid grasp of business finance, capital budgeting, margin preservation, and the financial impact of engineering decisions.
* **Communication & Leadership:**

 + Exceptional executive presentation and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing senior client stakeholders, suppliers, and internal executive teams.
 + Outstanding analytical reasoning, complex problem solving, and decisiveness in fast-paced manufacturing settings.

**Work Environment & Physical Guidelines**

* Modern, well-lit, climate-controlled manufacturing and engineering office environment.
* Compliance with facility Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) standards, including ESD-safe apparel and safety footwear in designated production zones in accordance with OSHA and facility guidelines.

identity_held_roles.description:
Job Type
 
 
Full-time
 
 
**Description**
BLOX designs, manufactures, and constructs buildings and delivers them as products across the country. DesignManufactureConstruct is the system we use. DMC moves complexity to the left: work the industry solves in the field, we move to the factory; work the factory struggles with, we eliminate at design. Manufacturing runs as a visually controlled, continuous-flow pull system, managed to takt with the minimal buffers required to stabilize flow. The BLOX system works, proven through multiple products and launches. Our next step is to encode that experience into a manufacturing launch system that is repeatable, teachable, and capable of supporting the scale ahead of us. That means converting what our best people know into standard work, tooling, interfaces, controls, and training. It also means knowing which parts of the system are load-bearing, where volume creates pressure, and having the judgment to strengthen or replace what no longer serves the work. Growth will test every system. Our job is to be ready first.
 
 
The Director of Manufacturing Launch owns manufacturing setup in Launch, from design and first-of-a-kind production through ramp to stabilization, until a building can be consistently produced as a Product. Launch runs as a horizontal through the verticals, and it has three leaders: design, manufacturing, and program management. You are manufacturing. You control line setup, standard work, tooling, takt, and training. You do not control product design, supply chain, construction, or the customer, but you work with and influence all. Each of the three launch leaders builds a team beneath them, all held to one goal. You build the manufacturing launch team, and you resolve manufacturability while the work is still in design. Then you document the baseline, train the operations team, transfer the role, and repeat. Nothing gets thrown over a wall. A line is not finished until the people running it can run it without you.
 
 
**Requirements**
We are completing the launch and stabilization of a major product, with a strong pipeline behind it. Current-line attainment and new-product launch are distinct jobs, and this role exists so both can be done well. Your mandate is to build on what BLOX has already learned and make launch repeatable. We are looking for:
 
 

* A manufacturing expert. Layout, flow, takt, tooling, line-side setup. Has built lines, not just improved them.
* A process expert. Standard work, first-pass yield, the discipline to prove a method before scaling it and to replace it when the evidence says you should.
* A systems thinker. Understands design, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and field installation, and resolves problems where they are best eliminated.
* A team builder. Hires, teaches, and promotes engineers who outgrow the org chart.
* A simplifier. Drives to the simple answer on the far side of the complex one, and does the work to get there.

Our team is strong. They built this system and accomplished more, faster, than most teams ever attempt, and they are accountable for attainment on the line running today. Our growth now supports separating manufacturing launch leadership from steady-state operational leadership.
 
 
We build like a startup and operate like a manufacturer: if you have only worked where the plant, the budget, and the org chart already existed, this will be uncomfortable. Five years out: a billion dollars, the same system running across multiple factories, DMC at meaningful scale, and a system capable of helping reshape the fastest-growing sector in building. DMC belongs to the industry, not to us, so what you encode here does not stay here. This is not a place to move a thousandth in a decade. Here, you matter.
 
 
The seat: Director of Manufacturing Launch, reporting to the COO in close partnership with the CEO. Based in Birmingham, Alabama, with occasional travel to launch sites.
 
 
**Benefits**
BLOX offers the full spectrum of comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short term disability, long term disability, life insurance and a 401k plan.
 
 
It is the policy of BLOX LLC to use ability and willingness to contribute to our team effort as the criteria for making employment related decisions, regardless of an individual’s race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other protected status. In addition, we strictly prohibit the harassment of any employee because of his/her race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), disability, or other protected status.
