**Your Dreams, Our Future.**
Join the dynamic and diverse team at Shiseido Americas, a subsidiary of the world-renowned Shiseido Company Limited. Be a part of a portfolio of prestige beauty brands which includes Clé de Peau Beauté, Drunk Elephant, Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare, NARS, SHISEIDO and several prestige fragrance brands including Issey Miyake, Narciso Rodriguez and Tory Burch. At Shiseido Americas we value and celebrate human diversity, with a rich tapestry of employees from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Headquartered in New York City with US offices and facilities located in New Jersey, Ohio, Texas and Florida, Shiseido Americas employs over 2,000 individuals in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Shiseido Americas is a hub of talent and innovation. Be inspired by the array of skills, knowledge, and integrity of your colleagues, and join our driving force as Shiseido continues its pursuit of beauty innovations for a better world.
  
  
At Shiseido Americas, we focus on our people. We strive to foster a collaborative workplace culture where creative thinking, inclusivity and unique diverse perspectives are celebrated in order to drive success for both our employees and the company as a whole. By prioritizing our team and promoting an open-minded environment, we push the boundaries of what's possible and bring new ideas to life.
  
  
WHERE YOU WILL WORK
  
  
Without compromising our steadfast commitment to Quality, Safety and Sustainability our manufacturing and packaging facility produces in excess of 70MM units per year. This is a demonstration of our can-do attitude, collaborative spirit, focus on innovation and continuous improvement mindset. Always People First!
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing, is responsible for overseeing day-to-day manufacturing operations, including providing leadership to supervisors and direct labor employees and maintaining short- and long-term batch schedules. This role ensures effective execution of the manufacturing schedule, adherence to established procedures, compliance with safety requirements, and timely communication and coordination with cross-functional departments.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* You will ensure employees are properly trained in safety and quality requirements
* You will ensure compliance with Company safety policies and procedures, as well as applicable Occupational Safety & Health Administration (OSHA) and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) requirements.
* You will work in partnership with the Bulk Planner to prepare the manufacturing schedule.
* You will ensure trial and launch batches are appropriately scheduled to meet project timelines.
* You will execute the manufacturing schedule while ensuring the most efficient use of resources.
* You will investigate batch upsets or nonconformances and prepare a formal report.
* You will implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize defects, product contamination, and material or component mix-ups.
* You will establish a regular meeting cadence with maintenance to discuss preventive maintenance schedules, equipment breakdowns, and corrective actions to improve equipment uptime.
* You will ensure all incidents, near misses, and safety concerns are reported immediately and addressed appropriately.
* You will monitor adherence to the manufacturing schedule and communicate delays that may extend a run beyond the scheduled completion date.
* You will identify process improvement opportunities and implement prioritized improvements based on business needs.
* You will administer employee corrective actions when appropriate and in accordance with Company policies.
* You will oversee the scale up and scale down of batches to meet business demand.
* You will contribute to capital investment decisions and support factory acceptance testing (FAT) of equipment.
* You will lead the partnership with NPC to ensure launches are completed on time, in full, and in accordance with quality requirements.
* You will partner with AIC to obtain technical support for new products and technologies.

**Who You Are**

* You have a four-year degree in physical science, engineering, or a related field
* You have at least five years of experience supervising or managing batch manufacturing operations within the cosmetics, pharmaceutical, chemical, or a related industry.
* You have a working knowledge of cosmetic formulations and manufacturing equipment operation.
* You are trained and experienced in current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).
* You possess excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving, and leadership skills.
* You demonstrate the ability and commitment to effectively lead and develop others.
* You are familiar with Microsoft Office applications.
* You can apply root cause analysis techniques to identify and resolve problems.

**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, if applicable. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
Employees must be able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by the area of work or tasks being performed. Required PPE may include, but is not limited to, eye protection, hearing protection, safety shoes, gloves, or additional protective clothing.
  
  
**Physical Requirement**

**Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA)**

  

**Discover Veranova:**

  

At Veranova, we believe people are our most important asset, and we are dedicated to building the most talented workforce in our industry. Our commitment to uncompromising focus on quality, compliance, safety, and excellence in delivery shapes everything we do. We are not just looking for skills; we are seeking innovative individuals who have a mindset open to learning and growth, and a desire to make a difference. Every role at Veranova plays a part in delivering an exceptional customer experience through ownership and integrity.

  

Veranova is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of complex active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for pharma and biotech customers. With deep technical expertise and impressive flexibility, we develop solutions and processes that support and accelerate innovation.

  

Join us on our mission to enable current and next-generation therapeutics to improve and save the lives of patients.

  

**Role Overview:**

  

The Sr Manager, QA is responsible for leading the Veranova Quality Assurance team, managing quality oversight of the manufacturing process and associated operations. This includes leading and managing multiple QA teams for batch record review, batch disposition, and on the floor QA support to ensure GMP compliance across all stages of manufacturing, as well as disposition and release of starting materials and customer facing Quality program leads for each client. The person filling this role will be responsible for the leadership, development and training of team members within their oversight as well as providing supportive leadership and strategic direction to operate with and maintain compliance to regulatory and industry quality standards. The role is expected to build strong collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive compliance and continuous improvement of GMP operations.

  

The position is 100% on site 1st shift at our Devens, MA facility.

  

**Core Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Evaluate and implement systems, methods, techniques, and solutions to complex quality compliance issues.
  
* Interface with Clients for project planning, and problem resolution with a strong customer service approach.
  
* Lead or support implementation of critical compliance systems and provide recommendations to operations management.
  
* Recommends the stop of any manufacture and/or distribution of a product if necessary.
  
* Manages the review, approval, and ensures delivery of Quality Assurance related training content and programs including new Quality Assurance initiatives for continuous improvement.
  
* Analyzes trends associated with data, proficiency testing, equipment/supply/reagent defects and supports development of solutions as appropriate.
  
* Direct and advise the Quality Assurance group to achieve long and short-term goals and objectives.
  
* Develops, improves, and revises Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Quality Policies as required/needed.
  
* Ensures the review and approval of equipment qualification protocols and results.
  
* Participates in internal auditing programs to assure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards.
  
* Partner collaboratively with Production, Maintenance, and QC for all Quality decisions within the scope of the role.
  
* Additional assignments/ duties to support team objective and contribute to the Veranova mission may evolve based on business needs.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

  

  
* BS or MS in Chemistry, Engineering or related field required.
  
* Must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance in an FDA regulated industry. Experience in an API in GMP environment is preferred.
  
* Minimum of 7 years of supervisory experience required; Proven ability to lead and coach, and motivate employees, clearly communicate job requirements, and effectively manage performance of staff.
  
* Must have established experience in Analytical and Quality Control support of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API).
  
* Knowledge and previous experience with GMP, ICH Q7, and 21 CFR Part 11; Expertise in FDA regulations, GMPs, and Quality Systems relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing.
  
* Experience with hosting and/or regulatory facing inspection responsibilities is required.
  
* Knowledge of Inventory Management, LIMS, Quality Management software systems experience desired.
  
* Must be a change agent and have strong interest in succession planning and professional development of their team(s); Ability to change priorities in response to company demands while continuing to deliver exceptional work quality through leadership by example.
  

  

**Salary Range:**

  

The salary range for this role is $155,000–$175,000. This range represents a good‑faith estimate of the compensation we expect to offer for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In exceptional cases, compensation may exceed the stated range.

  

All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our annual incentive bonus program. Bonus targets vary by career level and are based on individual and company performance.

  

**Our Commitment:**

  

  
* Health & Wellness:
  Comprehensive health & wellness benefits. Access to mental health resources and wellness programs. Generous PTO and holiday pay policies.
  
* Financial Wellness:
  Veranova is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. This includes a competitive base salary, eligibility for performance-based bonuses, and an attractive 401(k) Plan with company match. Salary ranges reflect the scope and expectations of the role, and are based on market data, internal equity, and role-specific factors. Final compensation may vary depending on experience, skills, education, and business needs.
  
* Professional Development
  : Opportunities for continuous learning through LinkedIn Learning, workshops, conferences, and mentorship. Tuition Assistance for Undergraduate and Graduate degree programs.
  
* Inclusive Culture:
  At Veranova, an inclusive culture is integral to our values. We welcome people with diverse experiences and perspectives who share our mission to improve and save lives. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Veterans, first responders, and those transitioning from military to civilian life bring valuable skills that strengthen our team.
  

  

**Additional Information:**

  

Applicants for this role must be authorized to work in the United States without further employer sponsorship.

  

Agency and Search Firm Representatives
: Veranova does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting.

  

For applicants who may require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, you may submit your request by sending an email to talentacquisition@veranova.com in order to confirm your request for an accommodation. Please include the job number, title, and location of role. This option is reserved for individuals who require accommodation due to a disability. Information received will be processed by a U.S. Veranova employee and then routed to a local recruiter who will provide assistance to ensure appropriate consideration in the application or hiring process.

  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

It is the policy of Veranova to provide equal employment access and opportunity to all persons regardless of age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, physical or mental disability, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

  

All applications are carefully considered, and your details will be stored on our secure Application Management System. protected_roles.description:
Req ID: 141867
  
  
Remote Position: No
  
  
Region: Americas
  
  
Country: USA
  
  
State/Province: California
  
  
City: San Jose
  
  
**Summary**
The Director of NPI (New Product Introduction) Program Management is an executive-level leadership role responsible for the end-to-end orchestration, risk management, and operational execution of next-generation hardware products from concept to mass production. In this role, you will lead and scale a high-performing team of Manufacturing Technical Leads (MTLs) who serve as the critical operational bridge linking Design Technical Leads, Software Engineering Program Managers, Factory NPI Managers, and Operations/Engineering teams. The Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring that multi-layered technical risks are identified and mitigated early, hardware prototype builds are executed flawlessly on schedule, build plans are thoroughly validated, and strict Phase-Gate exit criteria are met across the entire product lifecycle.
  
  
Detailed Description
  
  

* People Management & Technical Team Leadership
* MTL Group Leadership: Directly manage, mentor, and build a world-class team of Manufacturing Technical Leads (MTLs), establishing clear performance metrics and cultivating a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and cross-functional influence.
* Resource Optimization: Strategically allocate MTL resources across a complex portfolio of parallel hardware and software programs based on product complexity, tier-1 customer demands, and factory constraints.
* Technical Escalation: Act as the primary operational escalation point for programmatic and technical bottlenecks, unblocking the team by facilitating rapid engineering alignment and executive decision-making.
* Cross-Functional Bridging & Stakeholder Management
* Factory Integration: Ensure seamless synchronization between Design teams and Factory NPI Managers, translating product requirements into execution-ready factory directives.
* Operations & Engineering Alignment: Partner closely with internal Front-End, Back-End, and Test Engineering Senior Managers to ensure manufacturing infrastructure, SMT processes readiness, box build automation, and test fixtures scale alongside prototyping phases.
* Design & Software Synthesis: Direct the team in bridging the gap between hardware Design Technical Leads, Software Engineering Program Managers and the manufacturing teams to ensure that firmware, diagnostics, and silicon features are operationally aligned with hardware/software testing timelines.
* Prototyping Execution & Build Plan Validation
* On-Time Prototyping: Drive accountability across the team to ensure all early-stage hardware prototype builds (e.g., Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT) are executed on time and to precise quality standards.
* Build Plan Validation: Authorize and validate master product build plans, ensuring material readiness, factory capacity, component-level tooling, and custom test vectors are verified prior to firing up production lines.
* Build-Specific SOW Discipline: Enforce a strict documentation discipline requiring a comprehensive Scope of Work (SOW) to be authored, reviewed, and locked down for each individual build stage to clearly define build objectives, hardware configurations, and engineering deliverables.
* Deviation & Yield Controls: Supervise the tracking and resolution of design-induced or process-induced anomalies during builds, ensuring engineering deviations are strictly controlled, documented, and closed.
* Risk Mitigation & NPI Governance
* Predictive Risk Frameworks: Implement systemic risk-identification frameworks (utilizing NUDD, pFMEA, and CTQ parameters) to flag technical, supply chain, and manufacturability constraints months before physical builds commence.
* Rigorous Change Management: Establish and govern strict change management protocols across the product lifecycle, ensuring all mid-cycle design modifications, component substitutions, or process variations are fully documented, risk-assessed, and approved.
* Issue Tracking & Timely Escalation: Implement robust issue-tracking infrastructure to capture real-time build anomalies, driving cross-functional engineering teams toward rapid resolution or orchestrating structured, timely technical escalations before critical path schedules are impacted.
* Phase-Gate Governance: Own the operational readiness reviews and Phase-Gate exits for all active programs, ensuring engineering data, DFM/DFA, and yield validation metrics are eticulously prepared for executive leadership approval.
* Post-Mortem & Continuous Improvement: Lead comprehensive post-build teardowns and post-mortem evaluations to feed lessons learned back into early-stage hardware co-development loops.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  

* Technical & Process Depth: Deep mastery of standard product development lifecycles (PLC/NPI frameworks), advanced configuration management, and complex bill of materials (BOM) structures. Strong familiarity with hardware manufacturing processes (SMT, Box Build, Rack Integration, and Testing).
* Documentation & Governance Acumen: Solid proficiency in establishing documentation baselines (such as build SOWs), running rigorous change control boards (CCB), and implementing automated bug/issue-tracking methodologies (e.g., Jira or equivalent tracking systems).
* Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional ability to operate in a highly matrixed environment, successfully commanding authority and building alignment between highly technical chip/software architects and factory floor operational leaders.
* Programmatic Acumen: Proven track record of managing multimillion-dollar prototyping budgets, complex global supply chains, and demanding critical-path schedules with high volatility. PMP or equivalent program management certification is a plus.

Physical Demands
  
  
Typical Experience
  
  

* 12+ years of hardware program management or NPI engineering experience within high-performance compute, networking, hyperscaler, or tier-1 consumer electronics sectors, with at least 5 years in a direct people-management capacity.

Typical Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, or Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline.. A Master’s degree in Engineering Management or an MBA with a technical background is highly preferred.

Educational Requirements may vary by Geography
  
  
Notes
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
  
  
Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
  
  
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.
  
  
**Company Overview**
Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.
  
  
Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):
  
  
**ATS:**
This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.
  
  
**CCS:**
This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth.
  
  
Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.
  
  
Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  
  
Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

**About Us**
Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. When they want to push the limits of what’s possible with high voltage applications, they turn to us to make it happen.
  
  
While Spellman is not a household name, our products are used to make and often power many of the most advanced technologies that make modern life possible. With design and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe and Asia, we have become the preferred provider of high voltage power solutions for OEMs pushing the boundaries of technology around the world by designing and producing the products they need to power progress.
  
  
The primary role of the Senior Manager, NPI will provide leadership to a diverse team of engineers and provide support in the design, documentation, analysis, and coordination of release for products being transferred from design to production. The Senior Manager, NPI will contribute to the success of projects as well as the team. In this role, the Senior Manager, NPI will balance the work within the team, coach the team through technical challenges, and act as a role model in the organization. The Senior Manager, NPI will be expected to provide technical input to the leadership team to support business decisions.
  
  
This leader, with their team develops and implements operations requirements for design transfer across all product portfolios and collaborates with development, manufacturing and technical support teams to assure that all aspects of design for quality and manufacturability (DQM) are utilized for robust design development, transfer and ultimately scale up. Assures appropriate test method validations and product specifications are developed and implemented. Individual is also responsible for managing new part number creation and appropriate work instruction development. Will work cross functionally to ensure repeatability and reproducibility of the manufactured products within product and process capabilities and meeting of desired specifications.
  
  
Provides leadership of design transfer activities of products also engages in technology transfer activities involving product end of life or transfer to other Spellman High Voltage Electronics manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Establishes overall team direction and goals, and sets direction of resources toward completion of goals, in conjunction with Senior Leadership in both Development and Operations. Promotes an open, collaborative environment focused on teamwork
* Establishes and maintains design transfer project milestones and timelines
* Supports robust design specification development and validation activities during design transfer, working closely with counterparts in the development team.
* Oversight for all NPI deliverables to the customer and expected team output
* Communication with all members of the NPI team to monitor project status, scope changes, and KPIs
* Work with the Product Development teams to ensure that all new products have been put through the adequate testing and best practices have been used
* Work collaboratively with peers and other cross-functional team members including define sub-system design requirement specifications and design architectures
* Manage and collaborate across multi-technical disciplines and cross-functional teams
* Plan, manage, and delegate project resource requirements, schedules, and task activities.
* Resolve problems using solutions that involve new techniques, technologies, or concepts.
* Effective application of engineering excellence processes and techniques (DFMEA, PFMEA, DOE, DVP&R, boundary diagrams, DFM/A, Technical Design Reviews, fault tree and risk assessment, SCRUM, etc.)
* Lead a team of NPI Manufacturing Engineers, in collaboration with other organizations, to support production of complex products with responsibilities including but not limited to:
* Establish group and individual objectives, priorities, and metrics
* Ensure production of products meets expected output
* Ensure quality requirements are fulfilled and maintained
* Provide technical support for failure analysis and root cause investigation of product failures.
* Analyze manufacturing lines from a risk perspective (pFMEA) to incorporate and validate critical tests used in manufacturing.
* Assume responsibility for the validation of manufacturing equipment and processes leveraging standard qualification approaches (IQ/OQ/PQ/DQ/PPQ).
* Provide production line support for day-to-day engineering issues on production and NPI lines.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement projects with respect to first pass yield, cycle time reduction, product reliability, capacity enhancements, and cost reduction.
* Liaise between project management, engineering, and manufacturing functions to ensure project goals are on track
* Adherence to applicable QMS policies and procedures
* Ensure the team sets and meets reasonable deliverable expectations Review and approve engineering changes
* Facilitate problem-solving efforts and continually improve processes
* Understand, lead, and coach in DFX concepts, pFMEA, problem-solving, and transfer efforts
* Lead in the decision-making process for production planning and layout
* Evaluate and estimate the required and proposed engineering tasks (headcount or hours) Understand the product funnel and needs for NPI resources during the early phases of development
* Other duties as assigned by management

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 15 years of demonstrated experience in people management and leadership role
* Minimum of 10 years experience in electronics manufacturing and knowledge of Design Control guidelines
* Minimum of 10 years leading/managing New Product Introduction Teams; including hiring, employee development, managing subordinate managers, project planning, and coordination in a matrixed organization
* Strong Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent time management, planning, organization and problem solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor and coach team members
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with all levels of the organization as well as directly with key customer contacts
* Must be very good with materials, mechanical parts and electronic components logistics, planning, well organized and resourceful;
* Must be able to multitask in an environment requirement a high level of detail and accuracy, work independently with guidance and take ownership of all assigned tasks;
* Capable of presenting information to management team and influencing key stakeholders;
* Ability to relentlessly track and follow-up on open issues and action items;
* Prior responsibility for validation of processes, equipment, and products.

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Drive the design, implementation, and execution of company-wide improvement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Lead organizational transformation through change management best practices.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement by coaching leaders and teams in the Fluidra Operating System (FOS).

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and structured training.

* 8+ years of experience in Operational Excellence, manufacturing process improvement, or Operations leadership.

* Experience influencing at all organizational levels.
* Proficiency in Lean, Six Sigma, and/or Kaizen methodologies.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Experience managing multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

Master’s degree or MBA.

Smith®, and Zodiac®. We also sell products under the Cover‐Pools®, iAquaLink®, Grand Effects®, Del® and Nature2® names. **About Komline**

As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. Serving our core markets of Water & Process, Agricultural & Renewables, and Industrials, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive separation solutions precisely tailored to our clients' requirements. With a strong track record of strategic growth and acquisitions, Komline continues to expand its solution portfolio and technical capabilities while maintaining our commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

**This Opportunity**

The Director, Operational Excellence is responsible for building, deploying, and sustaining the Komline Business System (KBS), a consistent operating excellence system across all Komline sites. This leader will partner with Business Unit General Managers, Plant Managers, and functional leaders to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, working capital, productivity, and overall operating discipline while respecting the P&L accountability of each business. The role will lead Komline’s enterprise continuous improvement (CI) capability, develop CI talent, and ensure proven practices are shared and scaled across the network.

The successful candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader who combines strong Lean expertise with business judgment, credibility on the shop floor, and the executive presence to influence decentralized business leaders. This leader will be equally comfortable coaching a plant team, challenging a site improvement plan, and communicating enterprise priorities to senior leadership.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this enterprise-wide role supports all Komline operating sites.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead implementation of the KBS Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, standards, and multi-year improvement agenda across all sites
* Lead, coach, and develop the CI Manager team and other improvement resources; establish clear site coverage, priorities, and deployment expectations
* Partner with GMs and Plant Managers to identify the highest-impact opportunities and build robust, financially validated site-level improvement pipelines that deliver sustained results in safety, productivity, delivery, lead time, quality, inventory, cost, and working capital
* Establish and sustain common Lean / KBS operating practices, including daily management, visual management, standard work, problem solving, RCCM, value-stream improvement, kaizen, and leader standard work
* Create a practical maturity assessment for Operational Excellence and use it to prioritize coaching, capability building, and site support; track improvements in maturity and consistent adoption of core operating practices
* Drive measurable productivity and capacity improvements through flow, labor optimization, constraint removal, setup reduction, layout improvement, and waste elimination
* Partner with Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, EHS, Finance, Engineering, HR, and other enterprise functions to quantify benefits and ensure improvements are sustained
* Build CI capability within site leadership and frontline teams through training, coaching, kaizen leadership, and development of local change agents
* Establish common operational KPI definitions and review routines that enable benchmarking and the sharing and scaling of best practices across Komline
* Support acquisition integration by assessing operational maturity, identifying improvement opportunities, and integrating acquired sites into Komline’s operating system
* Provide regular enterprise-level reporting to the COO on CI pipeline, benefits realization, site maturity, risks, and resource priorities
* Promote a culture of accountability, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong partnership with decentralized business leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, operational excellence, industrial engineering, or related leadership roles
* Demonstrated success leading Lean / continuous improvement across multiple sites or business units
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management, kaizen, standard work, value-stream mapping, structured problem solving, and performance management
* Proven ability to influence GMs, Plant Managers, and functional leaders without relying on direct authority
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate operational improvements into measurable financial impact
* Excellent leadership, coaching, facilitation, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to travel approximately 50%+, depending on site and project needs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean leadership certification or equivalent and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
* Experience in multi-site industrial, engineered-product, capital-equipment, or process-equipment manufacturing
* Experience integrating acquired businesses or deploying a common operating system across decentralized businesses
* Experience with plant layout, flow optimization, capacity improvement, and working-capital initiatives
* MBA or advanced technical/operations degree

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**
Komline is an EEO employer – M/F/Vets/Disabled

The ideal candidate for this role will be based in Chicago or New York. When not traveling, this role would be hybrid splitting time between working in an Ankura office and remotely. Depending on candidate qualifications this role could be filled at the Director or Senior Director level.
  
  
The strongest candidate will bring hands-on manufacturing and industrials performance improvement experience, including plant operations leadership, enterprise value creation, CAPEX execution, Lean/Six Sigma, value stream performance, labor productivity, safety, quality, and operational transformation. A mix of corporate and consulting experience is prized, consulting only experience will be considered.

* Support clients through rapid growth, plant turnarounds, acquisition integrations, carve-outs, and broader cultural or operating model transformations, including M&A operational due diligence and pre/post-close execution.

protected_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **About Shield AI:**

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

### **Job Description:**

We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.

You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales.

This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements.

We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving.

**What you'll do:**

* **Build quality into prototype and launch**

  + Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve.
  + Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans.
  + Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented.
  + Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds.
  + Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks.

  **Establish the Seattle quality operation**

  + Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows.
  + Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements.
  + Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions.
  + Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions.

  **Deliver quality at rate**

  + Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow.

Your team is responsible for building and testing R&D vehicles for mileage collection and software validation, plus early builds of our next-generation ground-up vehicles. You will own assembly, diagnostics, testing, and End-of-Line (EOL), and help carry new vehicles into serial production.

Prototype builds surface new hardware and software issues every day. Success in this role depends on working closely with hardware and software engineering teams to resolve them fast, so you can meet production goals. You will set priorities, hold owners accountable, and escalate decisively when an issue blocks the build.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Manufacturing Engineering and General Assembly, you will be a key leader in Zoox Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Vehicle Development, Software, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and the teams operating our test fleet.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Own diagnostics, functional testing, and EOL validation. Deliver vehicles to fleet and engineering teams safely, complete, and on time.
* Implement repeatable build processes and keep accurate hardware and software configuration records for every vehicle. Ensure each vehicle meets quality and product specifications.
* Prepare and manage the line's OPEX, CAPEX, and headcount budgets. Identify investments that improve throughput, quality, and flexibility.
* Ensure MES and QMS support prototype builds, including traceability and issue tracking. Drive continuous improvement through the Zoox Production System.
* Hire, train, and develop technicians, leads, and supervisors. Set clear expectations and evaluate performance.
* Build a culture that puts employee and product safety first, in partnership with EHS. Enforce safe practices for high-voltage systems and pre-production vehicles.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in vehicle or complex electromechanical assembly manufacturing (e.g., automotive, aerospace, robotics), including prototype, pilot, or NPI builds.
* 5+ years of experience leading production teams, including supervisors or managers.
* Proven ability to lead hardware and software engineers to resolve build issues under schedule pressure, often without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of vehicle systems (mechanical, electrical, high-voltage, embedded software) and how they are built, diagnosed, and tested.
* Experience transitioning new products from prototype into serial production.
* Familiarity with MES, ERP, and QMS, and with structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis).
* Clear communicator who can present build status, risks, and trade-offs to executives.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with autonomous, electric, or other software-defined vehicles.
* Experience building or retrofitting R&D or test-fleet vehicles.
* Experience applying lean principles in low-volume, high-mix production.

Reporting to a Director of Clinical Quality Assurance, the Sr. Manager of Clinical Quality Assurance serves as a Development QA (DevQA) representative on the development team assuring quality and regulatory compliance related to GCPs and other related activities performed by Clinical Study (Trial) Teams. You will provide support and promote collaboration internally and externally to ensure all systems, processes and their outcomes comply with applicable international and national standards, regulations, and guidelines.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to Serve and maintain qualification as a GCP Subject Matter Expert (SME) as well as contribute to and support the maintenance of a risk-based and scientific-based quality system to support GCP. You’ll also:

  

* Ensure that a strategic audit plan is implemented and activities are conducted and reported according to SOPs and regulations.
* Perform audits of investigator sites, TMFs, vendors, and internal systems/processes.
* Support the evaluation and acceptability of clinical vendors/suppliers.
* Support strategic direction with cross functional working groups to identify and mitigate GCP quality and compliance issues.
* Establish and foster compliance with ICH E6 Guideline for Good Clinical Practice.
* Provide support and coaching to other staff members to develop additional quality and auditing resources.
* Manage quality documentation in Veeva QMS.
* Act as company’s representative during regulatory agency inspections.

**Who You Are:**

Basic Qualifications

You meet the following minimum education and experience requirements:

* BA/BS degree in Biology or Chemistry or related life sciences discipline along with a minimum of 5 years of GCP experience.
  

Preferred Qualifications

In addition to meeting the basic qualifications above, you will also possess some or all of the following:

* An understanding and practical working knowledge of clinical regulations, good clinical practices, development processes, and regulatory inspection procedures.
* Experience in developing SOPs, reviewing internal clinical, regulatory, and medical processes to ensure they are consistent with current regulatory and GCP requirements.
* GCP audit experience with the ability to conduct external audits of investigator sites, CROs, supporting laboratories, and monitoring organizations with responsibility for writing audit reports and reviewing and tracking CAPAs.
* Ability to conduct external audits of investigator sites, CROs, supporting laboratories, and monitoring organizations with responsibility for writing audit reports and reviewing and tracking CAPAs.
* Experience in supporting regulatory agency inspections and working with regulators and internal staff to help prepare for inspections.
* Broad knowledge of risk-based quality systems and approaches consistent with ICH E6 for Good Clinical Practice.
* Solid experience with Phases I-IV (particularly Phase III); experience with Regulatory approval, NDAs and MAAs is preferred.
* Ability to foster a collaborative/partnership environment, adapt to other personalities in a respectful manner that is conducive to goal achievement and team. building while maintaining quality and compliance.
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail, clarity, accuracy, and conciseness.
  

**Where You’ll Work**

This is a fully remote role. It can be performed effectively from anywhere while staying connected to your Insmed team and community. Occasional travel for team meetings or events may be expected.

**Travel Requirements**

This position involves frequent domestic/international travel (up to 25-30%) to support clinical QA including external audits.
